sa: तथा देहाद् विमुक्तस्य पूर्वं रूपं भवत्युत। अथ धूमस्य विरमे द्वितीयं रूपदर्शनम्॥
en: Such becomes the form of the Soul which has been separated from the body. When this fog disappears, a second form is seen.

sa: सत्यं दानं तपः शौचं कारुण्यं वागनिष्ठुरा। मित्रेषु चानभिद्रोहः सर्वं तेष्वभवत् प्रभो॥
en: And, O powerful one, truth, charity, penance, purity, inercy, sweet speeches, and absence of animosity towards friends, all these always lived in them.

sa: संन्यासफलिकः कश्चिद् बभूव नृपतिः पुरा। मैथिलो जनको नाम धर्मध्वज इति श्रुतः॥
en: Formerly there was a king of Mithila, of the name of Dharmadhyaja, of Janaka's race. He was given to the religion of Renunciation,

sa: नादं महान्तं मुक्त्वा स मूछितो गिरिमूर्धनि॥ विह्वल: प्रापतद् भूमौ हिरण्यकशिपोः सुतः।
en: Uttering a loud cry, he dropped down on the hill-top in a swoon. Indeed, the son of Hiranyakashipu dropped down on the Earth.

sa: एवमुक्तः स भगवान् वारिपूर्णेन चक्षुषा॥ जीवितं स्म कुमाराय प्रादाद् वर्षशतानि वै।
en: Thus begged, the illustrious god, taking up some water in his hands, granted to that dead child life extending for a hundred years.

sa: मम त्वं नाभितो जातः प्रजासर्गकरः प्रभुः। सृज प्रजास्त्वं विविधा ब्रह्मन् सजडपण्डिताः॥
en: You have originated from my navel. Gifted with power of creation, do you begin to create diverse kinds of creatures, rational and irrational.

sa: ते पश्यत सुतस्नेहो यादृशः पशुपक्षिणाम्। न तेषां धारयित्वा तान् कश्चिदस्ति फलागमः॥
en: Mark the affection that even birds and beasts cherish for their young ones. They get no return for rearing up their young ones!

sa: क्षेत्रज्ञं तं विजानीहि नित्यं लोकहितात्मकम्। तमो रजश्च सत्त्वं च विद्धि जीवगुणानिमान्॥
en: Know well what is called Kshetrajna and which had universal benevolence. Goodness, darkness, and ignorance are the three attributes of the living agent.

sa: प्रहर्षः प्रीतिरानन्दः साम्यं स्वस्थात्मचित्तता। अकस्माद् यदि वा कस्माद् वर्तन्ते सात्त्विका गुणाः।।२
en: Delight, cheerfulness, joy, equanimity, contentment of heart, due to any known cause or originating otherwise, are all effects of the quality of goodness.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि नरे पञ्च षष्ठं तु मन उच्यते। सप्तमी बुद्धिमेवाहुः क्षेत्रज्ञं पुनरष्टमम्॥
en: There are five senses in man. The mind is called the sixth. The Understanding is called the seventh. The Soul is the eighth.

sa: अक्षौहिण्यो दशैका च सप्त चैव महाद्युते। बलेन न समा राजन्नर्जुनस्य महात्मनः॥
en: The eleven Akshauhinis (of Duryodhana), and the seven (collected by yourself), were not, in power, equal to the single-handed Arjuna of great soul.

sa: तपस्विनी महाभागां वृद्धां दीक्षामनुष्ठिताम्। द्रष्टव्या सा त्वया तत्र सम्पूज्या चैव यत्नतः॥
en: Venerable for age and highly blessed, she is going through the initiatory rite. Seeing her there you should duly adore her with reverence.

sa: अस्मिन् हि लोकसम्भारे परं पारमभीप्सतः। उत्पन्ना मे मतिरियं कुतो धर्ममयः प्लवः॥
en: The desire has originated in my mind of crossing the ocean of the world. Alas, whence shall I get the vessel of religion?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच दिष्ट्या दृष्टोऽसि मे पुत्र कृतविद्य इहागतः। एतान्यत्यद्भुतान्येव कर्माण्यथ महात्मनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these marvellous and most wonderful deeds of the great Mahadeva sung by the ascetics, the son of Pandu became amazed.

sa: आह पुत्रांस्ततः सोऽथ स्त्रीभूतः पार्थिवोत्तमः। सम्प्रीत्या भुज्यतां राज्यं वनं यास्यामि पुत्रकाः॥
en: Having said thus to his children, the king went to the forest. Arrived there, she arrived at a hermitage inhabited by an ascetic.

sa: पतिव्रता सत्यशीला नित्यं चैवार्जवे रता। कथं न प्रत्युदेत्यद्य स्मयमाना यथा पुरा॥
en: Why does not that simple and truthful lady, devoted to her husband, alas reply as she used to do before with sweet smiles.

sa: ततः सिद्धस्य तपसा तव विप्र शकुन्तकाः। क्षिप्रं शिरस्यजायन्त ते च सम्भावितास्त्वया॥
en: When you had at last acquired ascetic success, certain birds were born on your head. You took great care of the little creatures:

sa: सा श्रुत्वा शोकसंतप्ता पपात वरवर्णिनी। भूमौ सत्यवती राजन् छिन्नेव रुचिरा लता॥
en: Hearing this, O king, the excellent lady Satyavati, filled with sorrow, dropped upon the ground like a beautiful creeper cut in two parts.

sa: उत्तानाभ्यां च पाणिभ्यां पादावस्य मृदु स्पृशेत्। दक्षिणं दक्षिणेनैव सव्यं सव्येन पीडयेत्॥
en: He should gently touch his preceptor's feet with palms, the right foot with the right hand and the left foot with the left.

sa: स सप्तदशकेनापि राशिना युज्यते च सः। एवं बहुविधः प्रोक्तः पुरुषस्ते यथाक्रमम्॥
en: The acting Soul is endued with the seventeen possessions. Thus is it said that there are innumerable kinds of Souls in due order.

sa: अष्टौ प्रकृतयश्चैव प्रकृतिभ्यश्च यः परः। अस्य देवस्य यद् भागं कृत्स्नं सम्परिवर्तते॥
en: You are the eight Prakritis. You are, again, above the eight Prakritis. Every thing that exists, represents a portion of your divine Self.

sa: दमस्तेजो वर्धयति पवित्रं दम उच्यते। विपाप्मा निर्भयो दान्तः पुरुषो विन्दन्ते महत्॥
en: Self-control increases one's energy. Self-। control is said to be sacred. The man of selfcontrol becomes sinless and fearless and acquires great results.

sa: यावत् स्थास्यन्ति गिरयो यावत् स्थास्यन्ति सागराः। तावत् तवाक्षया कीर्तिः सपुत्रस्य भविष्यति॥
en: As long as the hills will last, as long as the ocean will last, so long will the fame of your son continue.

sa: सा निःसृत्य तथा खेभ्यो दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रिता। स्मयमाना च सावेक्ष्य देवौ विश्वेश्वरावुभौ॥
en: Coming out of his body, she betook to the southern quarter and she smilingly cast glances at those two lords of the universe.

sa: कोऽथ वोत्सहते जेतुं त्व पुमान वर्षता शरवर्षा ग संयुगे बैशसं कृतम्॥
en: What person, O foremost of the Bharatas, dared variquish yi" this day, when showering a arrows downpour, you spread havoc among my troops.

sa: अलाबुपात्रे च तथा विषं दुग्धा वसुंधरा। धृतराष्ट्रोऽभवद् दोग्धा तेषां वत्सस्तु तक्षकः॥
en: Next the snakes milked her and they received poison for milk in in gourds. Dhritarashtra became the milker and Takshaka became the calf.

sa: एष ह्यस्य जये कालो निर्दिष्टो विश्वयोनिना। एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु वचनं देवदूतेन भाषितम्॥
en: This is the moment fixed by the creator for getting success over this one.” Having heard these words uttered by the celestial messenger.

sa: इदं वः क्षत्रिया द्वारं स्वर्गायापावृतं महत्। गच्छध्वं तेन शक्रस्य ब्रह्मणः सहलोकताम्॥
en: "O Kshatriyas, this broad door is wide open for you to enter heaven. Go through it to the abodes of Indra and Brahma.

sa: नाराचा निशिताः संख्ये सम्पतन्ति स्म भारत। व्यात्तानना भयकरा उरगा इव संघशः॥
en: Whetted long shafts, 0 Bharata, began to rain on all sides of the field of battle, like dreadful reptiles with mouths wide open.

sa: अहं ते रक्षणं युद्धे करिष्यामि महाबल। वारयन् रथिनः सर्वान् साधयस्व पितामहम्॥
en: I, myself O mighty hero, shall look to your protection, epulsing all the car-Warriors of the eneray's host. Do you overthrow the grandfather.

sa: राजपुत्रं तदा कन्यास्तपनीयस्वलंकृताः। कन्यां कन्यां शतं नागा नागे नागे शतं रथाः॥
en: And beautiful dansels adorned with ornaments of gold. With each damsel were a sons hundred elephants and with each elephant a hundred chariots.

sa: तथा भागविपर्यासौः संग्रामे भैरवे सति। वीराः समासदन् वीरान् कुर्वन्तो भैरवं रवम्॥
en: Thus during that sanguinary engagement in which no rule for selection of antagonists was followed, heroes encountered heroes, uttering aloud their respective war-cries.

sa: संजय उवाच तथा तु वदतां तेषां प्रादुरासीद् धनंजयः। दिक्षुर्भरतश्रेष्ठं राजानं ससुहृद्गणम्॥
en: Sanjaya said When they were thus conversing, Dhananjaya appeared there, desirous of seeing that foremnost of Bharatas, viz., king Yudhishthira and his relatives.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच यथा युयुधिके वीराः कुरुपाण्डवसोमकाः। कुरुक्षेत्रे तपःक्षेत्रे शृणु त्वं पृथिवीपते॥
en: Vaishampayana said ruler of carth, hear how those great warriors, the Kurus, the Pandavas and the Somakas foughton the holy field of Kurukshetra.

sa: न्यमज्जंस्ते महाराज तस्य काये महात्मनः॥ यथा हंसा महाराज तडागं प्राप्य भारत।
en: These shafts, O monarch, entered into the body of the illustrious Dushasana, like swans, O Bharata, diving into the waters of a lake.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं तव तेषां च भारत। अन्योन्य निजतां राजन् यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम्॥
en: Then ensued a fight, as they slew on another, between your troops and theirs, that added considerably to the population of Death's domain.

sa: संजय उवाच तथा द्रोणमभिनन्तं साश्वसूतरथद्विपान्। व्यथिताः पाण्डवा दृष्ट्वा न चैनं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing Drona thus destroy their horses, drivers, cars and elephants the Pandavas were greatly afflicted and could not check his career.

sa: तस्य क्रुद्धः स नागेन्द्रो बृहतः साधुवाहिनः। पदा युगमधिष्ठाय जघान चतुरो हयान्॥
en: But that foremost of elephants angrily placed his let on the yoke of (Shalya's) car and killed his four large and swift horses.

sa: अभ्यद्रवत् सुसंक्रुद्धो विधुन्वानो महद् धनुः। स पार्थं त्रिभिरानर्छत् सप्तत्या च जनार्दनम्॥
en: Burning with rage and twanging his great bow, rushed furiously on him. He then pierced Partha with three and Janardana with seventy shafts.

sa: धर्मापेक्षी नरो नित्यं सर्वत्र लभते सुखम्। प्रेत्यभावे च कल्याणं प्रसादं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: The man who depends of righteousness, is sure to reap happiness always and everywhere. After death, he obtains bliss and grace (of god).

sa: आस्तां ते स्तिमिते सेने रक्ष्यमाणे परस्परम्। सम्प्रसुप्ते यथा नक्तं वनराज्यौ सुपुष्यिते॥
en: Protected by Drona and Arjuna respectively, the two armies, appeared to stand still like two blossoming forests, in the silence of the night.

sa: तेषामथ विलापानां नायं दुर्योधनः स्मरेत्॥ हतौ हि पुरुषव्याघ्रौ भीष्मद्रोणौ त्वमात्य वै।
en: Does Duryodhana now remember all those lamentations of mine? You say that Bhishma and Drona, those two foremost of men, have been killed.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततः स भगवान् देवो लोकानामीश्वरेश्वरः। ब्रह्मणं प्रत्युवाचेदं स्निग्धगम्भीरया गिरा॥
en: Bhishma said Thereupon that almighty Divinity the Lord of the lords of people, thus replied to Brahma in a soft and sonorous voice.

sa: पाण्डवानां प्रतापेन दुर्गं देशं निवेश्य च। सपत्नान् सततं बाधन्नार्यवृत्तिमनुष्ठितः॥ आश्चर्यं वै सदा तेषां पुरा राज्ञां सुदुर्मतिः। ततो युधिष्ठिरे भक्तः कथं संजय सूदितः॥
en: In consequence of the prowess of the Pandavas and in consequence of placing himself amid entanglement, Duryodhana had recourse (for sometime) to honourable behaviour. Once that wicked-minded prince had to seek their protection, why, therefore. O Sanjaya, had Shveta, who was devoted to Yudhishthira, been killed?

sa: तान् दृष्ट्वा जाछवीपुत्रः प्रोवाच तनयं तव॥ धनं दत्त्वा विसृज्यन्तां पूजयित्वा चिकित्सकाः।
en: Beholding them, Ganga's son said to your son. “Paying proper respect to these physicians, and rewarding them with money, do you dismiss them.

sa: दुःशासनस्य रुधिरं पीयतां यदि शक्यते। यद् ब्रीवीषि च कौन्तेय धार्तराष्ट्रानहं रणे॥
en: Drink the blood of Dushasana, if you can. O son of Kunti, what you said namely, that in battle, the sons of Dhritarashtra,

sa: संग्रामे निहता ये ते दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः। त इमे नृषु सम्भूता घोररूपा महाबलाः॥
en: Those Daityas, and Danavas, and Rakshasas of dreadful appearance and of great might who were slain in battle, have been born among men.

sa: तां तथावादिनीं श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा च स महातपाः। राजर्षिः कृपयाऽऽविष्टो महात्मा होत्रवाहनः॥
en: That king of great austerities, the greatsouled royal sage Hotravahana, seeing her and hearing her speak in that way, became filled with pity.

sa: संजय उवाच व्युष्टायां तु महाराज शर्वर्यां सर्वपार्थिवाः। पाण्डवा धार्तराष्ट्राश्च उपातिष्ठन् पितामहम्॥
en: Sanjaya said O monarch, after the night had passed away, all the kings belonging to the Pandava and Dhritarashtra hosts approached the grandsire.

sa: एतत् कृत्वा महाराज धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। व्यात्ताननो यथा कालस्तव सैन्यं जघान ह॥
en: Achieving this feat, O mighty monarch, Yudhishthira the son of Dharma fell to slaughter your army, like the Destroyer himself with gaping mouth.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्येवं तेषु विप्रेषु चिन्तयत्सु यथातथम्। राजर्षिस्तद् वनं प्राप्तस्तपस्वी होत्रवाहनः॥
en: Bhishma said While those regenerate persons were thus thinking of the merit of the case, the royal sage Hotravahana came into that forest.

sa: अम्बोवाच न शक्यं काशिनगरं पुनर्गन्तुं पितुर्ग्रहान्। अवज्ञाता भविष्यामि बान्धवानां न संशयः॥
en: Amba said I cannot go to the city of Kashi to my father's place for I shall doubtless to disgraced by my friends.

sa: तथैव कृतवर्मा च कृपः शल्यश्च मारिष। विद्ध्वा नाकम्पयत् कार्ष्णि मैनाकमिव पर्वतम्॥
en: O sire, Kritavarmana, Kripa and Shalya, piercing Arjuna's son, all failed to make him, waver for he stood firm like the Mainaka mountain.

sa: उपानीतं तु पानीयं दृष्ट्वा शान्तनवोऽब्रवीत्। नाद्यातीता मया शक्या भोगाः केचन मानुषाः॥
en: Thereupon Shantanu's son beholding water brought for him said "This day forward, O son, I will no longer use articles of human enjoyment.

sa: शिखण्डी तु महेष्वासः सोमकैः संवृतो बली। इरावांश्च ततः पुच्छे मकरस्य व्यवस्थितौ॥
en: The fierce bowman Shikhandin, of great prowess being surrounded by the Somakas, together with Iravan, was stationed in the tail of that array.

sa: ननु नाम समं युद्धमेष्टव्यं युद्धजीविभिः। इदं चैवासमं युद्धमीदृशं यत् कृतं परैः॥
en: Those who live by fighting should surely desire equal combats. But his battle that the enemy fought with Abhimanyu was extremely unfair one.

sa: तावत् ते पाण्डवैवीरैः सौहार्द मम रोचते। युद्धं मदन्तमेवास्तु तात संशाम्य पाण्डवैः॥
en: It likes me best to see amity established between you and the heroic Pandavas. Let, O sire, peace by concluded with the Pandavas.

sa: येन लोकत्रयं क्रोधात् त्रासितं स्वेन तेजसा। तथा नीलेन निर्भिन्नः सुमुक्तेन पतत्त्रिणा॥
en: Who, possessed by rage, struck terror into the three worlds by the display of his energy. Thus pierced by Nila with well-directed shafts,

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच यानि लिङ्गानि संग्रामे भवन्ति विजयिष्यताम्। तानि सर्वाणि भगवञ्छ्रोतुमिच्छामि तत्त्वतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said O reverend sir, I desire to hear from you all those signs that happier before those that become victorious in battle.

sa: यच्चापि सर्वभूताना बीजं तदहमर्जुन। न तदस्ति विना यत् स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्॥
en: I am, O Arjuna, that which is the seed of all things. There is nothing movable or immovable which can exist without Me.

sa: अथाभ्येहित्वमागच्छ किं भीतोऽसि क्व यास्यसि। स्थितोऽहं समरे मा भैरिति चान्ये विचुक्रुशुः॥
en: Others cried, "Come, come to .his side why are you frightened? Where do you go? I stand in battle. Do not be afraid”.

sa: यांतु कृष्णार्जुनौ सेनां यां सात्यकिवृकोदरौ। रक्षेरन् को नु तां युध्येच्चमूमन्यत्र कौरवैः॥
en: The army which Krishna and Arjuna and Satyaki and Vrikodara protect what persons except the Kauravas would hazard a battle with that army.

sa: दृष्ट्वा निवर्तितं रामं सुहृद्वाक्येन तेन वै। लोकानां च हितं कुर्वन्नहमप्याददे वचः॥
en: Beholding that Rama desisted (from battle) at the words of his well-wishers, I also, for the good of the worlds, accepted (their) words.

sa: नान्तो विक्रमयुक्तस्य बुद्ध्या युक्तस्य वा पुनः। कर्मणां शक्यते गन्तुं हृषीकेशस्य संजय॥
en: Verily, O Sanjaya, none can reach the end (of the account) of of achievements Hrishikesha who is endued with prowess and intelligence. or

sa: काम्बोजस्य च दायादे हते राजन् सुदक्षिणे। श्रुतायुधे च विक्रान्ते निहते सव्यसाचिना॥
en: When also, O king, the heir of the king of Kambojas, namely prince Sudakshina, also the powerful Shrutayudha, had been slain by Savyasachin.

sa: तथापि बाणैर्निहतं श्वो द्रष्टासि रणे मया। सत्येन च शपे कृष्ण तथैवायुधमालभे॥
en: Still you shall behold him tomorrow slain by my arrows in battle. O Krishna, I swear by my truth and touching my weapons.

sa: यमात् कुबेराद् वरुणादिन्द्राद् रुद्राच्च यन्मया। उपात्तमस्त्रं घोरं तद् द्रष्टारोऽत्र नरा युधि॥
en: In tomorrow's battle, men will see those terrible weapons displayed by me which I have secured from Yama, Kubera, Varuna, Indra and Rudra.

sa: ते त्वाशुगतिना तेन त्रास्यमाना नरर्षभाः॥ तमेकं द्विरदं संख्ये मेनिरे शतशो द्विपान्।
en: Those foremost of men being frightened by that swift-coursing elephant, regarded that single one to be multiplied into hundred elephants, in that battle.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं कौरवाणां भयावहम्। तत्र पाण्डुसुतैः सार्धं भीष्मस्य विजयं प्रति॥
en: Then the contest that ensued between the sons of Pandu and the Kauravas for the conquest of Bhishma, became terrible to the extreme.

sa: स्नुषां चास्या वयस्याश्च विशोकाः कुरु माधव। साम्ना सत्येन युक्तेन वचसाऽऽश्वासय प्रभो॥
en: O Madhava, go, assuage the grief of my daughter-in-law and her companions; O lord, console them with your soft words fraught with truth.

sa: सारथिं चास्य भल्लेन गाढं विव्याध मर्मणि॥ विशोकं प्रेक्ष्य निर्भिन्नं भीमसेनः प्रतापवान्।
en: Then he pierced Bhima's charioteer deeply into the vitals with a broad-headed shaft. Then the mighty Bhimasena, beholding his charioteer Vishoka thus mangled,

sa: पाण्डवेषु च नाथेषु वृष्णिवीरेषु वा विभो। पञ्चालेषु च वीरेषु हतः केनास्यनाथवत्॥
en: O son! having the Pandavas, the Vrishni heroes and the Panchalas for your protector, by whom have you been slain like one helpless?

sa: तेषां च पृष्ठतो राजा बलेन महता वृतः। जयद्रथस्ततो राजा सूचीपार्वे व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Behind their back, was stationed · king Jayadratha by the side of the needle array and surrounded by a mighty division of troops.

sa: दधे मतिं विनाशाय राज्ञः स पिशिताशनः। जग्राह च महाशक्तिं गिरीणामपि दारिणीम्॥
en: That cannibal formed a fixed resolution for destroying the king. Thereafter the Rakshasa grasped a mighty lance, capable of penetrating even through rocks,

sa: आददानं गजाश्वानां नृणां चायूंषि भारता क्षणेन भूयः पश्यामः सूर्ये मध्यंदिने यथा।॥
en: The next moment, O Bharata, we beheld him shining like the mid-day sun and wrenching the lives out of elephants, steeds and men.

sa: पूर्णे शतसहस्रे द्वे पादातानां नरोत्तमः। प्रजज्वाल रणे भीष्मो विधूम इव पावकः॥
en: And full hundred thousands of foot soldiers, that foremost of men, Bhishma, seemed to blaze forth like fire without a streak of smoke.

sa: सर्वतः समवारयत्। तं रथं रथिनां श्रेष्ठाः परिवार्य परंतपाः॥ अवाकिरशरैस्तीक्ष्णैः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: That foremost of car-warriors Yudhishthira, having surrounded Bhagadatta with cars on all sides, covered the latter with keen-pointed shafts by hundreds and thousands.

sa: संग्रामशिरसो मध्ये सर्वेषां तत्र पश्यताम्। तां दृष्ट्वा तादृशीं मायां राक्षसस्य दुरात्मनः॥
en: In the very thick of the fright, before the very eyes of all the combatants, seeing that; illusion forth by that wicked-souled Rakshasa,

sa: शिखण्डी तु ततः क्रुद्धः सौमदत्तिं विशाम्पते। नवत्या सायकानां तु कम्पयामास भारत॥
en: O ruler of men, Sikhandin, filled with rage, picrced the son of Somadatta with ninety shafts and, O Bharata, caused hinm to tremble.

sa: भीष्मे हते भृशं दुःखान्मन्ये शोचन्ति पुत्रकाः। अद्रिसारमयं नूनं हृदयं मम संजय॥
en: I am sure, my sons are bewailing in grief for the death of Bhishma. O Sanjaya, my heart is surely made of stone.

sa: शिवेनाभिवदामि त्वां गच्छ युध्यस्व शत्रुभिः। अनुशाधि कुरून् संख्ये धत्स्व दुर्योधने जयम्॥
en: I do bid you farewell in benedictory language; go and fight with enemy; command the Kurus in battle and secure victory for Duryodhana.

sa: भवान् पौत्रसमोऽस्माकं यथा दुर्योधनस्तथा। तवापि धर्मतः सर्वे यथा तस्य वयं तथा॥
en: Like Duryodhana, you are to us our grandson. Therefore, by the ordinances, we are the same to you as we are to him.

sa: संजय उवाच पूर्वाह्ने तस्य रौद्रस्य युद्धमह्नो विशाम्पते। प्रावर्तत महाघोरं राज्ञां देहावकर्तनम्॥
en: Sanjaya said O king, in the morning of that awful day commenced the fearful battle that mangled the bodies of so many kings.

sa: उत्पेतुः सहसा राजन् हंसा इव महोदधौ। ते त्वदीयान् समासाद्य हयसंघान् मनोजवान्॥
en: O king, suddenly appeared on the field like swans on the bosom of the mighty-main. Those horses encountering your division of fleetest steeds,

sa: जयद्रथो रणे पार्थं विद्ध्वा भारत सायकैः। भीमं विव्याध तरसा चित्रसेनरथे स्थितः॥
en: Then, O Bharata, Jayadratha who was riding on the car of Chitrasena, having pierced Partha in battle, pierced Bhima also with his arrows.

sa: शरा दश दिशो राजंस्तेषां मुक्ताः सहस्रशः। न भ्राजन्ते यथातत्त्वं भास्करेऽस्तंगतेऽपि च॥
en: The sun having gone down, the arrows, O king, shot by thousands by them, did no longer illuminate the ten points as before.

sa: अद्य पश्यतु मे शल्य बाहुवीर्यं धनंजयः॥ अस्यतः कङ्कपत्राणां सहस्राणि शतानि च।
en: O Shalya, Arjuna will witness today the strength of my arms when I will discharge hundreds and thousands of Kanka feather were arrows.

sa: नकुलस्तु ततः क्रुद्धस्तव पुत्रं च सप्तभिः। जघान समरे राजन् सहदेवश्च पञ्चभिः॥
en: Nakula then, O king, being greatly enraged, struck you son with seventy three arrows and Sahadeva with five. Filled with anger he struck.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो दुर्योधन राजा कर्णशल्याववारयत्। सखिभावेन राधेयं शल्यं स्वाञ्जल्यकेन च॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon the king Duryodhana stopped Karna Shalya, addressing the son of Radha as a friend and requesting Shalya with joined hands.

sa: शल्यानुद्धृत्य पाणिभ्यां परिमृज्य च तान् हयान्। उपावर्त्य यथान्यायं पाययामास वारि सः॥
en: Drawing the arrows out of their bodies and shampooing them with his two hands and walking them duly, he made them drink water.

sa: एवमेष क्षयो वृत्तः पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते। क्रुद्धेऽर्जुने तथा द्रोणे सात्वते च महारथे॥
en: Thus continued that dreadful destruction of creatures when, O ruler of men, Arjuna, Drona and the mighty car-warrior Satyaki were excited with wrath.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रेण भीष्माय द्रोणाय च विशाम्पते। विसृष्टा पृथिवी सर्वा सह पुत्रैश्च तत्परैः॥
en: Dhritarashtra, O monarch, gave the earth to Bhishma and Drona and what was more, he entrusted them with the lives of his sons.

sa: दिनानि दश भीष्मेण निघ्नता तावकं बलम्॥ शून्याः कृता रथोपस्था हताश्च गजवाजिनः।
en: Massacring the (Pandava) troops for ten days together, Bhishma rendered the terraces of many a car empty and slew numberless elephants and steeds.

sa: कृष्णस्य चापि विदितं सर्वमेतत् पुरा ह्यभूत्॥ यथा पितामहो जज्ञे भगवान् सारथिस्तदा।
en: All this, namely how the Grandsire, that illustrious one, acted as the charioteer on that occasion, had fully been known to Krishna beforehand.

sa: अथ दस्युभयात् केचित् तदा तद् वनमाविशन। तत्रापि दस्यवः क्रुद्धास्तानमार्गन्त यत्नतः॥ बहुश्रुतः।
en: At a time certain persons, being afraid of robbers, entered the woods. Even there the robbers, filled with anger, doggedly haunted after them.

sa: ते गदे सहसा मुक्त समासाद्य परस्परम्॥ संघर्षात् पावकं मुक्त्वा समेयातां महीतले।
en: Those two maces hurled with force, clashing against one another emitted fire in consequence of the dash and then fell on the ground.

sa: संजय उवाच तथा परुषितं दृष्ट्वा सूतपुत्रेण मातुलम्। खङ्गमुद्यम्य वेगेन द्रौणिरभ्यपतद् द्रुतम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Seeing his maternal uncle thus insulted by the charioteer's son, the son of Drona brandishing his scimitar ran furiously towards him.

sa: कृष्णश्च समरश्लाघी तावत् संशाम्य पाण्डवैः। यावद् भीमो महाबाहुर्विगाह्य महतीं चमूम्॥ पाण्डवैः।
en: And Krishna also, that giver of joy, conclude peace with the Pandavas. Before the mighty-armed Bhima, piercing through this vast array of yours.

sa: द्रोणो न सैनयं बलवत् कामेत् तत्र कथंचन। एष द्रोणविनाशाय समुत्पन्नो हुताशनात्॥
en: There Drona will not be able to pierce with force, our troops. For the destruction of Drona, Dhrishtadyumna has come out of fire.

sa: शरवर्षं तु तत् कर्णः पार्थिवैः समुदीरितम्। शरवर्षेण महता समन्ताद् व्यकिरत् प्रभो॥
en: That downpour, of shafts discharged by the kings on all sides, was destroyed by the puissant Karna with a heavy shower of arrows.

sa: रथौ तयोः श्वेतहयौ दिव्यौ युक्तौ महात्मनोः। यौ तौ कर्णार्जुनौ राजन् प्रहृष्टावभ्यतिष्ठताम्॥
en: O monarch, both the cars, ridden by Karna and Arjuna, had gray steeds loudly as they careered with beautiful banners on their tops.

sa: हत्वा तु समरे कर्णं त्वमद्य निशितैः शरैः। विपुला प्रीतिमाधत्स्व धर्मपुत्रस्य मानद॥
en: O bestower of honors, secure the blessings of the son of Dharma, by shooting down Karna with the keen points of your arrows.

sa: कृच्छ्रान् दुर्योधनो लोकान् पापः प्राप्स्यति दुर्मतिः। यस्य लोभाद् विनिहताः समरे क्षत्रियर्षभाः॥
en: ‘Like a hungry tiger slaying inferior animals, Drona is slaying these Kshatriyas. Surely the wicked Duryodhana will obtain very miserable regions after Death.

sa: इदमङ्गिरसे प्रादाद् देवेशो वर्म भास्वरम्। तस्माद् बृहस्पतिः प्राप ततः प्राप पुरंदरः॥
en: The lord of the celestials gave this effulgent armour to Angiras; from him Brihaspati obtained it; and from him again Purandara got it.

sa: यमौ च द्रौपदेयाश्च राक्षसश्च घटोत्कचः। येषामर्थाय युध्यन्ते न तेषां विद्यते क्षयः॥
en: And the twins, the (five) sons of Draupadi and the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha are fighting for their sake. They (therefore) cannot meet with destruction.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नं च समरे हन्ताहं पापकारिणम्। कर्मणा येन तेनेह मृदुनो दारुणेन च॥
en: Either by hook or crook or by violent or mild measures I will achieve the slaughter of Dhristadyumna of evil deeds in battle.

sa: सात्यकिस्तु तदा कर्णं विंशत्या निशितैः शरैः॥ अताडयद् रणे शूरो जत्रुदेशे नरोत्तमः।
en: In that battle that foremost of men, the valiant Satyaki struck Karna with a score of sharp arrows hitting him on the shoulder-joint.

sa: ततः प्रतिकृतं मन्ये विधानं सात्यकिं प्रति। एवं निश्चित्य मनसा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Having done this, I should think my arrangements for the protection of Satyaki complete.” Thus resolving in his mind, king Yudhishthira the virtues.

sa: अथापरेण भल्लेन मुष्टिदेशे महद् धनुः। चिच्छेद तरसा युद्धे तव पुत्रस्य माधवः॥
en: The descendant of Madhu's race then cutoff the mighty bow of your son near the grasp, with broad-headed arrows shot with great force.

sa: विलयं समनुप्राप्ता च्च राजा न बुध्यते। इत्येवं क्षत्रियास्तत्र ब्रुवन्त्यन्ये च भारत।॥
en: All these are being destroyed; but the king (Duryodhana) heeds it not." Even thus did the Kshatriyas speak there. Others O Bharata, said

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा युधि विक्रान्तं सेनायां तव भारत॥ संशप्तकगणान् भूयः पुत्रस्ते समचूचुदत्।
en: Beholding him displaying such courage within his own army, O Bharata, your son tried once more to stir up the Samasaptakas against him.

sa: संजय उवाच मारिषाधिरथेः श्रुत्वा वाचो युद्धाभिनन्दिनः। शल्योऽब्रवीत् पुनः कर्णं निदर्शनमिदं वचः॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing the words of the great car-warrior Karna who took delight in battle Shalya again said to hiin, citing an example.

sa: यच कर्णोऽब्रवीत् कृष्णां सभायां परुषं वचः॥ प्रमुखे पाण्डवेयानां कुरुणां च नृशंसवत्।
en: (Verily you remember) the vile epithets that Karna so cruelly flung towards Krishna in the (Kuru) court before both the Kurus the Pandavas.

sa: पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां पदा चैनमताडयत्। एतत् ते कथितं राजन् यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि।॥
en: And in striking him with his legs in the presence of the whole army. O king now I have what you asked me.

sa: भीताः पादैहयान् केचित् त्वरयन्तः स्वयं रथान्। रथान् विशीर्णानुत्सृज्य पद्भिः केचिच विदुताः॥
en: Others overwhelmed with fear, fled on their cars having their axles, wheels and yokes broken. Others fled, hanging half way from their saddles.

sa: ततः सप्त स्थान् वीरः स्यालानां तव भारत॥ निहत्य भीमौ नाराचैः शतचन्द्रमपोथयत्।
en: Then the heroic Bhima, having killed seven car-warriors among your brothers-in-law, with arrows, buried Satachandra into the earth (by main force), O Bharata.

sa: असिं प्रासृजदाविध्य त्वरन् कर्णरथं प्रति। स धनुः सूतपुत्रस्य सज्यं छित्त्वा महानसिः॥
en: Then with great vehemence he hurled at Karna's chariot that sword; that mighty sword then cutting off the stringed bow of Suta's son.

sa: स विजित्य रणे शूरान् सोमकानां महारथान्। जगाम त्वरितस्तत्र यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Having vanquished (innumerable) horses as well as those great car-warriors the Somakas, he (i.e. Vrishasena) hastened to the spot where king Yudhishthira was.

sa: तान् बाणैः पञ्चविंशत्या साश्वान् राजन् नरर्षभान्। ससूतान् भीमधनुषो भीमो निन्ये यमक्षयम्॥
en: Then that fierce bowman Bhima, with twenty-five arrows dispatched to the abode of Yama, those foremost of men, with their steeds and charioteers.

sa: बोध्यमानं तु तत् सैन्यं राजंश्चन्द्रस्य रश्मिभिः । बुबुधे शतपत्राणां वनं सूर्यांशुभिर्यथा॥
en: Then, O king, all the troops were awakened by the beams of the moon like louses blown by the rays of the sun.

sa: सुयोधनबलं त्वद्य योधयिष्ये समन्ततः। विजेष्ये च रणे राजन् सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I will, this day, fight with the entire army of Suyodhana and vanquish it in battle, Oking. This I tell you for sooth.

sa: अयोधयस्ते सुभृशं तं शरौघैः समन्ततः। इन्द्रियार्था यथा देहं शश्वद् देहवतां वर॥
en: Those five princes, O foremost of embodied beings, fought with his discharging their numerous arrows, like the sense-objects ever fighting with the body.

sa: यथा मध्यंदिने सूर्यं प्रतपन्तं गभस्तिभिः। तथा तव सुतं मध्ये प्रतपन्तं शराचिभिः॥
en: As the noon-day sun scorches (the world) with his rays, so, it seemed, that your son scorched (the Pandavas army) with flaming darts.

sa: संजय उवाच युधिष्ठिरं महाराज विसृजन्तं शरान् बहून्। स्वयं दुर्योधनो राजा प्रत्यगृह्णदभीतवत्॥
en: Sanjaya said O great monarch, the king Duryodhana himself received, without any fear, was Yudhishthira, who then shooting innumerable shafts (at his antagonists).

sa: विरथं तं समालोक्य व्यायुधं च विशेषतः॥ द्रोणो व्यमोहयच्छत्रून् सर्वसैन्यानि वा विभो।
en: Beholding him careless and specially, weaponless Drona of firm vow and great lightness of hands held in bay all the enemy's soldiers, Olord.

sa: प्रतिरथास्तु वाहिका न च केचन मद्रकाः। स त्वमेतादृशः शल्य नोत्तरं वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Madras are called the dirt of all nations on earth so the Madra woman is called the dirt of the entire female sex.

sa: शतेन च शतं हत्वा पञ्चालानां महारथः॥ त्रिभिश्च निशितैर्बाणैर्हत्वा त्रीन् वै महारथान्।
en: Destroying one hundred mighty carwarriors of the Panchalas with a hundred arrows and slaying three foremost of (their) men with three sharpened arrows.

sa: ते हन्यमाना द्रोणेन पञ्चालाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्। पश्यतो भीमसेनस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः॥
en: The Panchalas, (thus) destroyed by Drona fled away in terror in the very presence of Bhimasena and in that of the high-souled Pritha.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच तस्मिन्नन्तर्हिते तूर्णं कूटयोधिनि राक्षसे मामकैः प्रतिपन्नं यत् तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Dhritarashtra said When that Rakshasa, after fighting by underhand measures, had thus disappeared, O Sanjaya, describe to me what befell my troops then.

sa: स शोभमानो वरदः खड्गी बाणी शरासनी। हसन्निवाब्रवीद् देवान् सारथिः को भविष्यति॥
en: Thereupon that beautiful boon-giver, who was excellently armed with the sword, arrow and bow, smilingly addressed the celestials saying-"Who will become my charioteer"'?

sa: ततो भल्लैः क्षुरप्रैश्च नाराचैर्विमलैरपि। गात्राणि प्राच्छिन्त् पार्थः शिरांसि च चकर्त ह॥
en: He with his long flat-pointed shafts and various other brilliant weapons and keen like razor, began to cut-off bodies and heads of enemies.

sa: सौबलस्तस्य समरे क्रुद्धो राजन् प्रतापवान्। विदार्य कवचं भूयो ध्वजं चिच्छेद काञ्जनम्॥
en: O king, the powerful son of Subala too, worked up with anger, cutting off his coat of mail, again sundered his golden standard.

sa: ते यूयं सहिताः सर्वे भृशं यत्ता महारथाः। द्रोणं रक्षत पाञ्चालाद् धृष्टद्युम्नान्महारथात्॥
en: United together and exerting your very best in (this) dreadful engagement, all of you protect Drona from that invincible and mighty car-warrior Dhristadyumna.

sa: अवस्छन्नौ ततः कष्णै दृष्ट्वा तत्र महारथाः। विस्मयं परमं गत्वा प्रेक्षन्त कुरवस्तदा॥
en: Beholding those two Krishnas covered with arrows the mighty car-warriors of the Pandava and Kuru armies, filled with great wonder, looked at them.

sa: तद् युद्धमासीत् सुमहद् घोररूपं परंतप। यादृशं न मया युद्धं दृष्टपूर्व विशाम्पते॥
en: Then O slayer of enemies, that battle became highly dreadful the like of which had never been seen by me before, O king.

sa: स शेते पृथिवीं नूनं शोभयन् रुधिरोक्षितः॥ मातङ्ग इव मत्तेन द्विपेन्द्रेण निपातितः
en: Surely having adorned the earth, he, besmeared with blood, sleeps in the ground, like an elephant killed by an infuriate lord of elephants.

sa: धनंजय महाबाहो मानितोऽस्मि दृढं त्वाय। माहात्म्यं विजयं चैव भूयः प्राप्नुहि शाश्वतम्॥
en: O Dhananjaya of mighty arms, I feel highly honoured by you, do you attain once more the greatness and victory you ever deserve.

sa: कर्ण प्राप्य रणे सूत मम पुत्रः सुयोधनः। जेतुमुत्सहते पार्थान् सगोविन्दान् ससात्वतान्॥
en: Obtaining Suta's son Karna to help him, my son Duryodhana is confident of securing victory over the Pandavas with Govinda and the Satwatas.

sa: संजय उवाच वर्तमाने महाराज संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे। व्याकुलेषु च सर्वेषु पीड्यमानेषु सर्वशः॥
en: Sanjaya said When that hair-stirring battle continued to be fought and when all the warriors were filled with anxiety and were greatly afflicted.

sa: ततस्ते विव्यधुः सर्वे द्रौणिं राजन् महारथाः। युगपच पृथक् चैव रुक्मपुत्रैः शिलाशितैः॥
en: Thereupon, O king, all those mighty carwarriors, simultaneously and separately began to pierce the son of Drona with gold-winged arrows whetted on stone.

sa: तानब्रवीत् ततः कर्ण क्रुद्धः सर्प इव श्वसन्। करं करेण निष्पीड्य प्रेक्षमाणस्तवात्मजम्॥
en: Thereupon Karna, who was filled with wrath and who sighed heavily like a serpent and who squeezed his hands and who looked at

sa: कर्णस्त्वेको युधां श्रेष्ठो विधूम इव पावकः। दहशत्रून् नरव्याघ्र शुशुभे स परंतपः॥
en: In the meantime while killing his enemies, that foremost of men the great warrior Karna, even destroying his foes, shone like smokeless fire.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो धनंजयो राजशिरसा प्रणतस्तदा। पादौ जग्राह पाणिभ्यां भ्रातुर्येष्ठस्य मारिष॥
en: Sanjaya continued O king, thereupon Dhananjaya bent his head low and with his hands took hold of the feet of his eldest brother.

sa: न हि मे विक्रमे तुल्यः कश्चिदस्ति पुमानिह। यथैव सवितुस्तुल्यं ज्योतिरन्यन्न विद्यते॥
en: Just as no luminary is equal to the Sun in effulgence, so there is no man equal to me in prowess and strength.

sa: यदृच्छया रणे भीमं युध्यमानं महाबलम्। कथंचिद् विरथं कृत्वा यत् त्वं सक्षमभाषथा:॥
en: By freak of fate, you succeeded in making Bhimasena carless. (And) you have committed a sin by abusing Bhima, O son of Radha.

sa: नानाविधानि सैन्यानि तव हत्वा तु सात्वतः। प्रविष्टस्तावकं सैन्यं द्रावयित्वा चमूं भृशम्॥
en: Then he of the Satvata race penetrated into the ranks of your army slaying troops of diverse kinds and crushing your army completely.

sa: राम प्रीतोऽस्मि भद्रं ते परितुष्टोऽस्मि लक्ष्मण। अभिवादयितुं यन्मां प्राप्तौ स्थः सह सीतया॥ अध्वश्रमेण वां खेदो बाधते प्रचुरश्रमः। व्यक्तमुत्कण्ठते वापि मैथिली जनकात्मजा ॥
en: 'O Rāma, I am pleased with you; good betide you! And, O Laksmana, I am gratified by you. You are in trouble in consequence of the great fatigue that you have undergone on the way. And Janaka's daughter, the noble Maithili, is evidently cager (for rest).

sa: अग्निं कुशान् काष्ठमपः फलं मूलं तथैव च। न्यवेदयत् सहस्राक्षो यच्चान्यदपि काङ्क्षितम्॥
en: The thousand-eyed one provided for her fire, and Kusa, and faggots, and water, and fruits, and roots, and other things that she wanted.

sa: किं करिष्यावहे वत्स क्व वा गच्छाव लक्ष्मण। केनोपायेन पश्यावः सीतामिह विचिन्तय॥
en: Do you ponder over, O brother, where shall we repair, what shall we do and by what means shall we come by Sītā?

sa: राज्याद् भ्रंशस्व कैकेयि नृशंसे दुष्टचारिणि। परित्यक्तासि धर्मेण मा मृतं रुदती भव॥
en: Do you bear yourself from this kingdom, O heartless and wicked Kaikeyī. Having been lost to righteousness, do not you lament me dead.

sa: अयं हि सर्वभूतानां मान्यस्तु नरसत्तमः। अस्मासु च गतः प्रीतिं रामः परपुरंजयः॥
en: And this foremost of men is worthy of being honoured by all creatures; and Rāmacaptor of hostile capitals—has also found delight in us.

sa: तानतीत्य समासाद्य भर्तारं निहतं रणे। समीक्ष्य व्यथिता भूमौ सम्भ्रान्ता निपपात ह॥
en: Passing them by and getting at her husband and beholding him killed in battle, she, losing her sense, fell down to the ground.

sa: नाराजके जनपदे कारयन्ति सभां नराः। उद्यानानि च रम्याणि हृष्टाः पुण्यगृहाणि च॥
en: In a kingless country men do not form themselves into associations, nor do they, inspired with cheerfulness, make elegant gardens or sacred edifices.

sa: वयमस्य यथा लोके संख्याताः सौम्य साधुभिः। भार्याः पुत्राश्च शिष्याश्च त्वमपि ज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: And this also you should learn that wives, sons and disciples should always be obedient as has been held by the emancipated ones.

sa: अनुत्तमं तद्वचनं नृपात्मजः प्रभाषितं संश्रवणे निशम्य च। प्रहर्षजास्तं प्रति बाष्पविन्दवो निपेतुरार्यानननेत्रसम्भवाः॥
en: Hearing that graceful speech of the king's son, tear-drops. begot of delight began to trickle from their eyes and adorned those noble countenances.

sa: तत्र यत्नश्च कर्तव्यो मार्गितव्या च जानकी। नहि तेभ्यो भयं किंचित् कपित्वमनुवर्तताम्॥
en: There you should heedfully search for Jānakī. you have no fear whatever from them; do you only follow your native nature as monkeys.

sa: न हि तावदतिक्रान्ताऽसुकरा काचन क्रिया। अद्य दुःखं तु वैदेही वनवासस्य वेत्स्यति॥
en: We have not yet performed any of the arduous tasks. To day Vaidehi will know the grief of a life in the woods.

sa: अवदारणकाले तु पृथिवी नावदीर्यते। विहीना या त्वया राज्ञा धर्मज्ञेन महात्मना ॥
en: Deprived of you, the high souled king cognisant of duty, the earth albeit her time of riving is come, is not yet riven.

sa: अपास्य हि रसान् भौमांस्तप्त्वा च जगदंशुभिः। परेताचरितां भीमां रविराचरते दिशम् ॥
en: Drawing moisture from the ground and heated the earth by his rays, the Sun goes to the dreadful quarter whither repair the dead.

sa: निर्विघ्ना व्रतचार्या सा भविष्यति सुरक्षिता। अहं तत्र गमिष्यामि न रामं नेतुमर्हसि॥
en: Then well protected, your sacrifice will hold an unimpeded course. Therefore, I will repair thither, and it behoves you not to take Rāma.

sa: यथेते नियमं पौराः कुर्वन्त्यस्मन्निवर्तने। अपि प्राणान् न्यसिष्यन्ति न तु त्यक्ष्यन्ति निश्चयम्।।२०
en: These citizens have determined upon making me turn back from the forest, they would rather renounce their lives than give up their resolve.

sa: पित्र्यं राज्यं समुत्सृज्य स नार्हसि नरोत्तम। आस्थातुं कापथं दुःखं विषमं बहुकण्टकम्॥
en: Therefore, O best of men, leaving your ancestral kingdom, you ought not to abide in the disagreeable forest filled with dangers and difficulties.

sa: पूर्वजा भगिनी चापि मम राघव सुव्रता। नाम्ना सत्यवती नाम ऋचीके प्रतिपादिता।७।।
en: O Rāghava, I had a sister of noble vows born before me. And her name was Satyavatī; and she was bestowed upon Rcīkā.

sa: मम सर्वविनाशाय सम्प्राप्तस्त्वं महामुने। न चैकस्मिन् हते रामे सर्वे जीवामहे वयम्॥
en: O mighty Muni, you have come here to compass the destruction of my all; but if Rāma be slain, we shall never live.

sa: यां गतिं सगरः शैब्यो दिलीपो जनमेजयः। नहुषो धुन्धुमारश्च प्राप्तास्तां गच्छ पुत्रक॥
en: Do you, O son, go the way that has been gone by Sagara and Saivya and Dilīpa and Janamejaya and Nahusa and Dhundhumāra.

sa: यदि त्वार्यं न शक्ष्यामि विनिवर्तयितुं वनात्। वने तत्रैव वत्स्यामि यथार्यो लक्ष्मणस्तथा॥
en: If I fail to bring back the noble one from the forest, I will like the exalted Lakşmaņa remain even in that forest.

sa: मां नीयोजय विक्रान्तं त्वं निवर्तस्व साहसात्। पश्य रामं महाबाहुं संयुगे विनीपातितम्॥
en: Do you employ me, who am possessed of prowess, and yourself desist from this rashness. Behold the mighty-armed Rāma brought down in battle.

sa: तस्य वै यजमानस्य पशुमिन्द्रो जहार ह। प्रनष्टे तु पशौ विप्रो राजानमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: And as he was sacrificing, Indra stole away his sacrificial beast. And on the beast being stolen, the priest said unto the king.

sa: अहत्वा नास्ति मे शक्तिः प्रतिगन्तुमितः पुरीम्। बिलद्वारि प्रतीक्ष त्वं यावदेनं निहन्म्यहम्॥
en: Without slaying (this Asura) I cannot return to the palace. Do you wait at the mouth of the cave while I slay him.

sa: ततो गत्वाऽऽश्रमपदं शिष्येण सह लक्ष्मणः ॥ दर्शयामासकाकुत्स्थं सीतां च जनकात्मजाम् ।
en: Threat, going to the asylum in company with the disciple (of Agastya), Laksmana showed to him Kākutstha and the daughter of Janaka, Sītā.

sa: समतिक्रम्य तं देशमुत्तरः पयसां निधिः। तत्र सोमगिरि म मध्ये हेममयो महान्।५३।।
en: Passing beyond that is the Northern ocean. In the bosom (of the deep) is the mountain named Somagiri, golden and of great dimensions.

sa: यथा निगदितं मात्रा तद् वाक्यं पुरुषर्षभः। श्रुत्वा रामोऽब्रवीद् वाक्यं मातरं भृशदुःखिताम्॥
en: Hearing those words of his mother, Rāma that best of men, spoke the following words to her, who was greatly troubled with sorrow.

sa: यथा नन्दति तेजस्वी सागरो भास्करोदये। प्रीतः प्रीतेन मनसा तथा नन्दय नस्ततः॥
en: Do you please us delightedly and with a glad heart, even as the strong ocean pleases people at the rising of the sun.

sa: अपवाह्य तु दुष्टात्मा भरतं तव बन्धुषु। काल्ये स्थापयिता रामं राज्ये निहतकण्टके॥
en: Having sent Bharata to the home of your relatives, that wicked-minded one will establish Rāma in his ancestral kingdom rid of its thorn.

sa: स गङ्गां प्राग्वटे ती, समायात् कुटिकोष्ठिकाम्। सबलस्तां स तीथि समगाद् धर्मवर्धनम्॥
en: Having crossed the Gangă at Prāgvața, he went over to the Kuţikoșthika. Having with his forces crossed that river, he proceeded to Dharmavardhana.

sa: यदाचरति कल्याणि शुभं वा यदि वाऽशुभम्। तदेव लभते भद्रे कर्ता कर्मजमात्मनः॥
en: As are the actions of one, O auspicious one, whether good otherwise, the consequences, O gentle lady, reaped by the doer of them.

sa: वानरा राजसिंहस्य यस्य यूयं पुरःसराः। तं विहाय सुवित्रस्ताः कस्माद् द्रवत दुर्गताः॥
en: O monkeys, why are you flying away, terrified and distressed, leaving behind that foremost of kings before whom you were used to fight?

sa: सिद्धार्थाः पितरं वृत्तं तस्मिन् काले घुपस्थिते। प्रेतकार्येषु सर्वेषु संस्करिष्यन्ति भूमिपम् ॥
en: Blessed are they that when the time shall come for the same, shall perform the funeral ceremonies of the king, my deceased sire.

sa: व्यक्तं सा भक्षिता बाला राक्षसैः पिशिताशनैः। विभज्याङ्गानि सर्वाणि मया विरहिता प्रिया॥
en: True it is that she has been devoured in my absence by the Rākşasas living on flesh having torn into pieces her limbs.

sa: न बुद्धिपूर्वं नाबुद्धं स्मरामीह कदाचन। मातृणां वा पितुहिं कृतमल्पं च विप्रियम्॥
en: I do not remember to have done on any occasion wilfully or unwilfully any thing that is displeasing to my father or mothers.

sa: इमे द्वे धनुषी श्रेष्ठे दिव्ये लोकाभिपूजिते। दृढे बलवती मुख्ये सुकृते विश्वकर्मणा॥
en: These two foremost of bows, extraordinary, and worshipped of all the worlds, and stout, and powerful, surpassingly excellent, constructed with care by Viśvakarman.

sa: ऋषिणा च पितुर्वाक्यं कुर्वता वनचारिणा। गौर्हता जानता धर्म कण्डुना च विपश्चिता।॥
en: The learned Rși Kandu, who lived in the forest keeping the word of his father, killed a cow, knowing it to be unrighteousness.

sa: तमार्तः सम्परिष्वज्य गुहो राघवमब्रवीत्। यथायोध्या तथेदं ते राम किं करवाणि ते॥
en: Thereat touched, Guha embracing Rāghava said to him, "O Rāma, as Ayodhyā this kingdom is to you. What shall I do for you?"

sa: सरितां तु पतिः स्वल्पां मर्यादां सत्यमन्वितः। सत्यानुरोधात् समये वेलां स्वां नातिवर्तते॥
en: And the lord of rivers, having promised, even on occasions of Parvas, does not pass over his bounds for the sake of truth.

sa: सीता यस्य स्नुषा चासीच्छरण्यो धर्मवत्सलः। तस्य पुत्रः शरण्यस्य सुग्रीवं शरणं गतः॥
en: That one attached to virtue, that refuge (of all)—the son of that shelter (of all beings) has come under the protection of Sugrīva.

sa: सारथे पश्य विध्वस्ता अयोध्या न प्रकाशते॥ निराकारा निरानन्दा दीना पतिहतस्वना ॥
en: O charioteer, behold that Ayodhyā, which shorn of its splendour and decorations, and plunged in grief, forlorn and silent, does not appear delightful.

sa: न च सीता त्वया हीना न चाहमपि राघव। मुहूर्तमपि जीवावो जलान्मत्स्याविवोद्धतौ॥
en: O Rāghava, deprived of you neither Sītā nor I can live for a moment, like fish taken out of water : without you.

sa: पूर्वकाले महाबाहो ये प्रजापतयोऽभवन्। तान् मे निगदतः सर्वानादितः शृणु राघव ॥
en: O mighty-armed one, I shall describe (to you) from the very beginning the (history of) those that were Prajāpatis in days of yore.

sa: प्रस्थाप्य चीरवसनं पुत्रं मे वनवासिनम्। कैकेयी के गुणं तत्र पश्यति क्रूरदर्शिनी॥
en: What is the good that is perceived by Kaikeyi of tortuous sight in sending away my son clad in bark to the woods?

sa: तामुवाच ततो रामः शबरी संशितव्रताम्। अर्चितोऽहं त्वया भद्रे गच्छ कामं यथासुखम्॥
en: Again spoke to Savarī of keen austerities-0 gentle one, I have been worshipped by you. Do you repair at your ease and pleasure.

sa: ततः पुष्पबलिं कृत्वा शान्तिं च स यथाविधि। दर्शयामास रामाय तदाश्रमपदं कृतम्॥
en: Then offering flowers, and duly performing rites for the peace (of the habitation), Lakşmaņa showed the asylum which he had made to Rāma.

sa: दृष्ट्वा रामं क्रियादक्षं सुग्रीवो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। हरिवागुरया व्याप्तां तप्तकाञ्चनतोरणाम्॥ प्राप्ताः स्म ध्वजयन्त्राढ्यां किष्किन्धां वालिनः पुरीम्। प्रतिज्ञा या कृता वीर त्वया वालिवधे पुरा ॥
en: You have reached Kiskindhā, Vāli's capital, adorned with gold, filled with pennons and instruments and surrounded by monkeys. Do you make good your promise, O hero, you hadst made before to encompass the destruction of Vāli like to the season making the creepers filled with fruits.

sa: स हि राजसुतः पुत्र चीरवासा महावनम्। दण्डकान् सह वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणानुचरो गतः॥
en: O son, that son of the king wearing bark has repaired to the forest of Dandaka, along with Vaidehi and followed by Lakşmaņa.

sa: तं च राजा दशरथो यशस्कामः कृताञ्जलिः। ऋष्यशृङ्ग द्विजश्रेष्ठं वरयिष्यति धर्मवित्॥ यज्ञार्थं प्रसवार्थं च स्वर्गार्थं च नरेश्वरः। लभते च स तं कामं द्विजमुख्याद् विशांपतिः॥
en: And king Dasaratha, knowing duty and desirous of fame, with the intention of obtaining offspring and heaven, with folded hands, will appoint that best of Brahmanas, Rsyasriga, to conduct the ceremony. And that bringer of good will attain his object at the hands of that foremost of Brāhmaṇas.

sa: नहि शक्या प्रवेष्टुं सा मयायोध्या त्वया विना। राजधानी महेन्द्रस्य यथा दुष्कृतकर्मणा॥
en: Even as a doer of evil deeds cannot enter the metropolis of the mighty Indra, I am incapable of entering Ayodhyā without you.

sa: एष ते राम गङ्गाया विस्तरोऽभिहितो मया। स्वस्ति प्राप्नुहि भद्रं ते संध्याकालोऽतिवर्तते॥
en: Thus, O Rama, have I defailed to you the history of Gangā. Auspiciousness may you obtain! Good betide you, the evening draw nigh.

sa: त्वत्सनाथः सखे संख्ये जेतास्मि सकलानरीन्। त्वमेव मे सुहृन्मित्रं साहाय्यं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: Assisted by you, my friend, I shall in battle vanquish all my foes. You being my friend and my ally, should assist me.

sa: तस्य रोषपरीतस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः। चचाल वसुधा कृत्स्ना देवानां च भयं महत्॥
en: And when the intelligent Viśvāmitra was exercised with wrath, the entire earth began to tremble, and the gods even were inspired with awe.

sa: अथ काले गते तस्मिन् षष्ठेऽहनि तदागते। सौमित्रिमब्रवीद् रामो यत्तो भव समाहितः॥
en: When time had thus gone by and the sixth day had arrived, Rāma said to Sumitrā's son. Being well equipped, be you vigilant!

sa: तद्गतं हृदयं यस्यास्तदधीनं च जीवितम्। अयोध्या हि भवेदस्या रामहीना तथा वनम्॥
en: Ayodhyā without Rāma would have seemed a wilderness to her whose heart is fixed on him and whose very life depends upon him.

sa: चक्षुषा त्वां न पश्यामि स्मृतिर्मम विलुप्यते॥ दूता वैवस्वतस्यैते कौसल्ये त्वरयन्ति माम्।
en: But I do not see you with my eyes, and my memory fails. These envoys of Vivasvata's son, OKausalya, urge speed upon me.

sa: रथस्थः स तु धर्मात्मा भरतो भ्रातृवत्सलः। नन्दिग्रामं ययौ तूर्णं शिरस्यादाय पादुके॥
en: And ascending the car, the virtuous Bharata attached to his brother, speedily went to Nandigrāma, holding the sandals (of Rāma) on his head.

sa: विवास्य रामं सुभगा लब्धकामा समाहिता। त्रासयिष्यति मां भूयो दुष्टाहिरिव वेश्मनि ॥
en: And that fortunate one having by her endeavours attained her end, will frighten me the more like a wicked serpent in one's house.

sa: तथोक्तो धर्मशीलेन भ्रात्रा तस्य हिते रतः। लक्ष्मणः प्रविवेशेव स्वानि गात्राणि लज्जया॥
en: Thus addressed by his brother of a virtuous disposition, Laksmana ever engaged in Rama's good, from shame seemed to enter into his body.

sa: राजा दशरथो नाम कश्चिदिक्ष्वाकुवर्धनः। तस्य पुत्रो महातेजा रामो नाम भविष्यति ॥
en: There shall be a king named Daſaratha, increaser of the Ikşwāku race. He shall have a son, named Rāma, endowed with exceeding energy.

sa: यदर्थं प्रतिषेधो मे क्रियते गन्तुमिच्छतः। एतदिच्छामि विज्ञातुं संशयो हि ममानघ ॥
en: I want to learn, Oh sinless one, why you do prevent me now from following you. I entertain a grave doubt in this.

sa: बहूनां वितता यज्ञा द्विजानां य इहागताः। तेषां समाप्तिरायत्ता तव वत्स निवर्तने॥
en: These numerous Brāhmaṇas that have come hither have entered upon many a sacrifice. The completion of these, O child, depends upon your return.

sa: अत्येति रजनी या तु सा न प्रतिनिवर्तते। यात्येव यमुना पूर्ण समुद्रमुदकार्णवम्॥
en: A night that has gone by, does not return, as the full Yamunā, when she has entered the ocean, does not come back.

sa: मां निहत्य तु रामोऽसावचिरात् त्वां वधिष्यति। अनेन कृतकृत्योऽस्मि म्रिये चाप्यरिणा हतः॥
en: Compassing my end Rāma shall exterminate you in no time and blessed I shall be being killed by an enemy in the conflict.

sa: लक्ष्मणेनैवमुक्तस्तु रामः सौमित्रिमब्रवीत्॥ मा स्म त्रासं वृथा वीर नहि त्वादृग् विषीदति।
en: Being thus addressed by Lakşmaņa, Rāma spoke to Saumitrī—Fear not in vain, O hero; persons of your prowess are never afflicted (with fear).

sa: उवाच च विषण्णः सन् राघवं राघवानुजः। पश्य मां विवशं वीर राक्षसस्य वशंगतम्॥ मयैकेन तु निर्युक्तः परिमुच्यस्व राघव। मां हि भूतबलिं दत्वा पलायस्व यथासुखम्॥
en: Being greatly distressed, the younger brother of Răghava spoke to him, saying Do you behold me, O hero, brought under the hold of this Raks asha, and renouncing me only, O Rāghava, do you get yourself cff. And offering me as sacrifice, do you escape at your ease.

sa: स मत्तकोयष्टिभकान् पादपान् पुष्पशालिनः। उद्वहन्नुरुवेगेन जगाम विमलेऽम्बरे॥ ऊरुवेगोत्थिता वृक्षा मुहूर्त कपिमन्वयुः। प्रस्थितं दीर्घमध्वानं स्वबन्धुमिव बान्धवाः॥ तमूरुवेगोन्मथिताः सालाश्चान्ये नगोत्तमाः। अनुजग्मुर्हनूमन्तं सैन्या इव महीपतिम्॥
en: Hanumān coursed through the sky along with these trees, borne up by the violence of his flight. The ſala and palm trees went after him for a short time as people follow their friends bound for a distant land, or as the troops follow their king.

sa: सदा? राजपुत्रौ द्वौ धर्मज्ञौ धर्मविक्रमौ। श्रुत्वा वयं हि सम्भाषामुभयोः स्पृहयामहे ॥
en: Blessed is he whose sons these, two cognizant of virtue and having truth for prowess are. Having heard their converse, we are delighted.

sa: अभिवाद्य वसिष्ठं च न्यायतः प्रतिपूज्य च। अब्रवीत् प्रश्रितं वाक्यं प्रसवार्थं द्विजोत्तमम्॥
en: Having saluted Vasiştha and duly paid him homage, he humbly spoke to that best of twiceborn ones, with the intention of having offspring.

sa: सा क्षौमवसना हृष्टा नित्यं व्रतपरायणा। अग्निं जुहोति स्म तदा मन्त्रवद् कृतमङ्गला॥
en: Wearing silk-cloth, pleased, and accustomed to the performance of religious rites every day, she, performing benedictory ceremonies, was offering oblation to the fire.

sa: ये तु त्वरयितुं याता वानराः सर्ववानरान्। ते वीरा हिमवच्छैले ददृशुस्तं महादुमम्॥
en: And it came to pass that those heroic monkeys that had gone away to spur others on, found a mighty tree on Himayat.

sa: भगवन् किं परित्यक्ता त्वयाहं ब्रह्मणः सुत। यस्माद् राजभटामां हि नयन्ते त्वत्सकाशतः॥
en: O Brahma's son, wherefore have I been forsaken by you, that the servants of the king were carrying me from off your presence?

sa: मोमुह्यमानां तां तत्र जगृहुः पञ्च पाण्डवाः। इन्द्रियाणि प्रसक्तानि विषयेषु यथा रतिम्॥
en: Seeing her overwhelmed with fear, the five Pandavas supported her, as the (five) senses influenced by desire are supported by the worldly objects.

sa: सा प्रीता बहुमानाच्च पतिं पर्यचरत् तदा। अगस्त्यश्च परां प्रीति भार्यायामचरत् प्रभुः॥
en: She being much pleased began to serve her. husband with great respect and the exalted Agastya also showed great love towards his wife.

sa: ते द्वन्द्वशः पृथक् चैव सिंहग्रीवा महौजसः। सिंहासनानि भूरीणि विचित्राणि च भेजिरे॥
en: Those lion-necked and greatly effulgeit (kings) took their seats separately and in praise on may high (royal) seats of various make and colour.

sa: यो हि दिष्टमुपासीनो निर्विचेष्टः सुखं शयेत्। अवसीदेत् स दुर्बुद्धिरामो घट इवोदके॥
en: He, who has been at ease without any action and believing in Destiny, is soon consumed like an unburnt earthen pot in water.

sa: अभिवादं करोम्येषां कुरूणां कुरुसंसदि। न मे स्यादपराधोऽयं यदिदं न कृतं मया।॥
en: I salute all my superiors in this assembly of the Kurus. It is not my fault if I have not done it before.

sa: यदा रुद्ररथं क्रुद्धो महिषः सहसा गतः। रेसतू रोदसी गाढं मुमुहुश्च महर्षयः॥
en: When Mahisha in great wrath thus seized the pole of Rudra's chariot, the earth began to groan and the great Rishis fainted away.

sa: ततः कृष्णा च भीमश्च यमौ च सुतपस्विनौ। शिरोभिः प्राप्य राजर्षि परिवार्योपतस्थिरे॥
en: Then Krishna and Bhima and the twins of good devotion, having bowed down to that royal sage with their heads, stood surrounding him.

sa: गङ्गायाधारणं कृत्वा हरो लोकनमस्कृतः॥ कैलास पर्वतश्रेष्ठं जगाम त्रिदशैः सह। समासाद्य समुद्रं च गङ्गया सहितो नृपः॥ पूरयामास वेगेन समुद्रं वरुणालयम्। दुहितृत्वे च नृपतिर्गङ्गां समनुकल्पयत्॥
en: Having held Ganga, Hara (Shiva), the adored of all the worlds, went to that foremost of mountains Kailasa with the celestials. Coming to the ocean with Ganga, the king. Foiled in the ocean, the abode of Varuna with the greatest force. That king adopted Ganga as his daughter.

sa: तथा हि रत्नान्यादाय विविधानि नृपा नृपम्। उपातिष्ठन्त कौन्तेयं वैश्या इव करप्रदाः॥
en: Various kings brought with them various kinds of wealth to the son of Kunti, king (Yudhishthira) and worshipped him like the tribute-paying Vaishyas.

sa: सा तत्र जज्ञे सुभगा विद्युत् सौदामनी यथा। विभ्राजमाना वपुषा व्यवर्धत शुभानना।॥
en: Taking her birth there, that exalted girl of beautiful face, as effulgent as the lightning, began to grow in body day after day.

sa: नित्यं क्रोधात् तपो रक्षेद् धर्म रक्षेच्च मत्सरात्। विद्यां मानापमानाभ्यामात्मानं तु प्रमादतः॥
en: A man must preserve his virtue, being overcome by anger, his righteousness by pride, his learning by vanity and his soul by illusion.

sa: दुःशासन उवाच एवमेतन्महाप्राज्ञ यथा वदसि मातुल। नित्यं हि मे कथयतस्तव बुद्धिर्विरोचते॥
en: Dushashana said: O greatly intelligent uncle, it is exactly as you say. The words of wisdom you utter always recommend themselves to me.

sa: विविशुस्ते सभां तां तु पुनरेव महारथाः। व्यथयन्ति स्म चेतांसि सुहृदां भरतर्षभाः॥
en: O best of the Bharata race,, giving great pain to the hearts of all their friends those great car-warriors again entered that assembly.

sa: त्वया विमथितं वीर स्ववीर्यतपसो बलात्। विध्वस्ते स्वपुरे तस्मिन् दानवेषु हतेषु च॥
en: Has been destroyed by you, O hero, by your prowess and strength of asceticism. That city being destroyed and the Danavas being killed,

sa: आख्यानमिदमाख्यातं सर्वपापहरं मया। य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं मनोश्चरितमादितः। स सुखी सर्वपूर्णार्थः सर्वलोकमियान्नरः॥
en: He who every day hears this old history of Manu obtains all happiness and all other objects of desires and goes to heaven.

sa: किंचिद् दैवाद्धद्दात् किंचित् किंचिदेव स्वकर्मभिः। प्राप्नुवन्ति नरा राजन् मा तेऽस्त्वन्या विचारणा॥
en: O monarch, by practising Yoga or by Destiny or by their own acts, men attain to (happiness or misery). Do not thing otherwise.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्तु निश्चेता गतसत्त्व इवाभवत्। न तं सूतं प्रत्युवाच वचनं साध्यसाधु वा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Yudhishthira sat like one demented and deprived of reason. He did not five any reply to the Suta, good or ill.

sa: तयोः प्रश्नविवादोऽभूत् प्रह्लादं तावपृच्छताम्। ज्यायान् क आवयोरेकः प्रश्नं प्रब्रूहि मा मृषा॥
en: When they thus quarrelled with each other, they hoth asked Prahlada, saying "Who amongst us is superior? Answer this question, don't speak falsely,"

sa: विदुर उवाच एवं विनिहतः संख्ये किर्मीरो मनुजाधिप। भीमेन वचनात् तस्यधर्मराजस्य कौरव॥
en: O ruler of men, O descendant of Kuru, it was thus that Kirmira was killed by Bhima at the command of Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira).

sa: लोमश उवाच शृणुष्वावहितो राजन् राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः। यथा मान्धातृशब्दो वै लोकेषु परिगीयते॥
en: Lomasha said: O king, hear with attention how the name of Mandhata, that high-souled king, came to be famous all over the world.

sa: ततो हाहाकृतमभूत् सर्वं किल विशाम्पते। द्यौश्च भूमिश्च खं चैतादृश्यमाने तथा मयि॥
en: O king, seeing me in that state, the heaven the sky and the earth were all filled with exclamation of “Oh" and "Alas."

sa: ततः स महिषः क्रुद्धस्तूर्णं रुद्ररथं ययौ। अभिद्रुत्य च जग्राह रुद्रस्य रथकूबरम्॥
en: Thereupon Mahisha was greatly enraged and the quickly advanced towards the chariot of Rudra. Reaching near, he seized its pole with his hands.

sa: अवश्यं क्रियमाणस्य कर्मणो दृश्यते फलम्। न हि निर्वेदमागम्य किंचित् प्राप्नोति शोभनम्॥
en: Our actions are with certainty followed by their effects. Whoever merely gives himself up to passive indifference (to worldly affairs) accomplishes no good.

sa: अस्याः सभामानयनं च चित्रमिति मे मतिः। एकाम्बरध रत्वं वाप्यथ वापि विवस्त्रता॥
en: In my opinion there is nothing surprising if she is brought before the assembly in one cloth or if she be made naked.

sa: मैथुनायेह सम्प्राप्ता कामं प्राप्तं दुतं चर। जामयो मां प्रतीक्षन्ते गमिष्यामि हुताशन॥
en: O Hutasana, I have come here to satisfy my desire. Kindly gratify me. My sister-in-law are waiting for me; I must soon return.

sa: एष कामो मे प्रथमः भगवन् भगनेत्रहन्। त्वत्प्रसादाद् विनिर्वृत्तः समर्थः स्यामहं यथा॥
en: O exalted destroyer of Vaga's eyes, my chief desire is that I may be able to fight with them and finally obtain victory.

sa: गुरूंश्च ब्राह्मणांश्चैव प्रणामप्रवणा: सदा। द्रोग्धव्यं न च मित्रेषु न विश्वस्तेषु कर्हिचित्॥ येषां चान्नानि भुञ्जीत यत्र च स्यात् प्रतिश्रयः। स त्वं प्रतिश्रयेऽस्माकं पूज्यमानः सुखोषितः॥
en: We are ever intent on bowing down to our superiors and the Brahmanas. A friend, a confiding man, he whose food has been partaken and he who has given shelter should never be injured; you have happily lived in our place and you were duly honoured by us.

sa: तथायुक्तं तु तं दृष्ट्वा मुमुदे स मुनिस्तदा। एवं स जनयामास भारतापत्यमुत्तमम्॥
en: Seeing him endued with such (prowess) that Rishi became very much pleased. O descendant of Bharata, thus did he beget that excellent son.

sa: अयं च शङ्खप्रवरो येन जेतासि दानवान्। अनेन विजिता लोकाः शक्रेणापि महात्मना।1८४॥
en: Here is that excellent conch by which you will conquer the Danavas. By (the help of) it, the high-souled Sakra conquered the worlds.

sa: गत्वा यत्र महाप्राज्ञ विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना। पुरा शौचं कृतं राजन् हत्वा दैतेयदानवान्॥
en: O greatly wise man, O king, here did Vishnu, the creator of the universe, after killing the Daityas and the Danavas, purify himself.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स गत्वा राजभवनं दुर्योधनवशानुगः। उवाच द्रौपदी सूतः प्रातिकामी व्यथान्वितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Going back to the palace, himself much distressed, the Suta, Pratikamin obedient to the command of Duryodhana, spoke thus to Draupadi.

sa: मम वै रोमकूपाणि विद्धि त्वं द्विजसत्तम। रत्नाकरा: समुद्राश्च सर्व एव चतुर्दिशम्॥
en: O foremost of Brahmanas, know them to be the pores of my skin. The oceans, those mines of gems and the four directions.

sa: निग्रहे प्रग्रहे सम्यग् यदा राजा प्रवर्तते। तदा भवति लोकस्य मर्यादा सुव्यवस्थिता॥
en: When a king justly punishes and shows favour, dignity of the law is then well maintained and all people live in good order.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र शृङ्गवेरपुरं महत्। यत्र तीर्णो महाराज रामो दाशरथिः पुरा॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go to the great Sringapur where, O great king, Dasharatha's son Rama formerly crossed (the Ganges).

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं विष्टम्भितस्तेन भगवान् पाकशासनः। किमर्थं भार्गवश्चापि कोपं चक्रे महातपाः॥
en: Yudhishthira said: Why the exalted chastiser of Paka, Indra, was paralyzed and the great ascetic, the descendant of Bhrigu got angry against him?

sa: ऐश्वर्यं हि महत् पुत्र त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्। भ्रातरः सुहृदश्चैव नाचरन्ति तवाप्रियम्॥
en: O son, all my vast wealth is at your command. Your brothers and our relatives and friends never do anything injurious to you.

sa: सुहृत्स्वजनवाक्यानि यथावन्न शृणोति च। ममापि च तथा वाक्यं नाभिनन्दति मोहितः॥ नूनं मन्ये न दोषोऽस्ति नैषधस्य महात्मनः। यत् तु मे वचनं राजा नाभिनन्दति मोहितः॥
en: Deeply engaged in the game, as he is deaf regarding the advices of his friends and relatives, so he does not accept my counsel. Surely me-seems, the high-souled Naishadha is not to be blamed for his not listening to my words, absorbed as he is in the game.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच इक्ष्वाको संस्थिते राजन् शशादः पृथिवीमिमाम्। प्राप्तः परमधर्मात्मा सोऽयोध्यायां नृपोऽभवत्॥
en: Markandeya said : O king, when Ikshvaku died, the greatly virtuous Shashada, becoming the king of Ayodhya began to rule over this earth.

sa: भ्राता मम सुहृच्चैव साक्षाद्धर्म इवापरः। तस्य स्मृत्याद्य सुभृशं हृदयं दीर्यतीव मे॥
en: Dhritarashtra said : My brother and my friend (Vidura) is like the God of Justice himself. Remembering him, my heart burns in grief.

sa: एषा सरस्वती रम्या दिव्या चौघवती नदी। एतद् विनशनं नाम सरस्वत्या विशाम्पते॥
en: O king, here is the charming celestials river full of water, named Sarasvati. It is here Vinasana of the Sarasvati (where she disappeared).

sa: शैब्या च सुषुवे पुत्रं कुमारं देवरूपिणम्। तदालावू समुत्स्रष्टुं मनश्चक्रे स पार्थिवः॥
en: The princess of Shaibya gave birth to a son as handsome as a celestials. That king then thought of throwing away the gourd.

sa: यमजौ चापि भद्रं ते नैतन्यत्र विद्यते। बलं तव यशश्चैवधर्मः कीर्तिश्च वर्धताम्॥
en: And also the twins (Nakula and Sahadeva). Be blessed; such courage does not exist in others. May your strength, fame and virtue increase.

sa: न ग्लानि च कातर्यं न वैक्लव्यं न मत्सरः। कदाचिज्जुषते पार्थमात्मजं मातरिश्वनः॥
en: Neither fatigue, nor fear, nor lassitude nor the malice (of others) took possession of that son of Pritha and god of the wind.

sa: स वै यत्नेन महता तासु पुत्रं महीपतिः। कंचित्रासादयामास कालेन महता ह्यपि॥
en: Though a long period of time passed away and though he took great care, yet he could not succeed in getting a son.

sa: अनागसं प्रियां भार्यां विजने श्रममोहिताम्। अपहाय तु को गच्छेत् पुण्यश्लोकमृते नलम्॥
en: Who excepts that righteous Nala, could go away, abandoning his beloved hand unoffending wife in the woods, when she was overtaken by fatigue?

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु शक्रेण फाल्गुनः परवीरहा। मुदं परमिकां लेभे न च शापं व्यचिन्तयत्॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Shakra (Indra), that slayer of hostile heroes, Falguni, became exceedingly glad and ceased to think of the curse.

sa: ततो मायाश्च ताः सर्वा निवातकवचांश्च तान्! ते वज्रचोदिता बाणा वज्रभूताः समाविशन्॥
en: And those arrows, turned into thunderbolt (on account of their) being shot from the Vajra, penetrated through the illusion and all the Nivatakavachas.

sa: को हि धर्मिणमात्मानं जानज्ञानविदां वरः। कुर्याद् यथा त्वया भीष्म कृतं धर्ममवेक्षता॥
en: O Bhishma, who will so act as you have from the motives of virtue, knowing himself to be virtuous and superior in knowledge?

sa: असूर्यमिव सूर्येण निर्वातमिव वायुना। भासितं ह्लादितं चैव कृष्णेनेदं सदो हि नः॥
en: This sacrificial ground is illuminated and gladdened by Krishna like a sunless region by the sun and a airless region by the air.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु दिव्यामाकाशाद् वाचं सर्वे विसिस्मियुः। ऋषीणां ब्राह्मणानां च पार्थिवानां विशेषतः॥
en: On hearing the celestials voice in the sky they were all surprised, more specially the Rishis and Brahmanas (who were with the Pandavas).

sa: स मासान् विभजन् काले बहुधा तथैव भगवान् सोमो नक्षत्रैः सह गच्छति॥
en: Similarly, the divine moon moves with the stars (round this mountain) dividing the mouth into many sections when he arrives at the Parvas.

sa: लोमश उवाच एषा मधुविला राजन् समङ्गा सम्प्रकाशते। एतत् कर्दमिलं नाम भरतस्याभिषेचनम्॥
en: Lomasha said: O king, here is visible the river Samanga which is also called Madhubela. Yonder is Kardamela, the bathing place of Bharata.

sa: न ह्येष मृगयाधर्मो यस्त्वयाद्य कृतो मयि। तेन त्वां भ्रंशयिष्यामि जीवितात् पर्वताश्रयम्॥
en: What you have done towards me is quite contrary to the usage of the chase. O mountaineer, therefore, I shall take your life.”

sa: यस्मादुद्विजते लोकः कथं तस्य भवो भवेत्। अन्तरं तस्य दृष्टैव लोको विकुरुतेध्रुवम्॥
en: How can good betide him of whom the people are afraid-forsooth do the people injure him as soon as they find a hole.

sa: स्वकर्म त्यजतो ब्रह्मन्नधर्म इह दृश्यते। स्वकर्मनिरतो यस्तु धर्मः स इति निश्चयः॥
en: O Brahmana, to abandon one's own duty is considered to be sin. To stick to one's own duty is certainly a meritorious act.

sa: क्षमाकालांस्तु वक्ष्यामि शृणु मे विस्तरेण तान्। ये ते नित्यमसंत्याज्या यथा प्राहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: Hear, I shall now describe to you the hours of forgiveness as pointed out by the learned and which should always be followed.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा राक्षसान् सर्वान् भीमसेनो ह्यमर्षणः। व्यगाहत महाबाहुर्नलिनी तां महाबलः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this to all the Rakshasas, the mighty-armed and exceedingly unforbearing and greatly strong Bhimasena plunged into the lake.

sa: अपकृष्य च लज्जां सा स्वयमुक्तवती नृप। प्रयतन्तां तव प्रेष्याः पुण्यश्लोकस्य मार्गणे॥
en: O monarch! unblushed with shame, Damayanti herself said that my men should try to find out the whereabouts of that virtuous king (Nala).

sa: गमिष्यामि महाप्राज्ञे रोचते मे वचस्तव। गाश्च मे दास्यते वैन्यः प्रभूतं चार्थसंचयम्॥
en: But, O highly wise (wife), I relish your proposal and will (therefore) go there. Vainya will bestow on me cows and immense wealth.

sa: ततो हिमवतः पार्श्व समभ्येत्य जलोद्भवम्। सर्वमल्पेन कालेन देशं चक्रे वशं बली॥
en: The powerful (hero), then arrived at the damp country at the foot of the Himalayas and soon subjugated the whole of that country.

sa: वरुणस्य तथा गौरी सूर्यस्य च सुवर्चला। रोहिणी शशिनः साध्वी स्वाहाचैव विभावसोः॥५
en: Varuna has Gouri for his consort, and the Sun God has Suvarchala. Rohini is the chaste wife of Shashin, and Svaha of Vibhavasu.

sa: सा च देवी महाभागा गान्धारी हतबान्धवा। पतिमन्धं कथं वृद्धमन्वेति विजने वने।॥
en: Alas, how does that highly blessed queen, Gandhari, whose dear ones have all been killed, follow her blind husband in the solitary forest.

sa: तपः प्रदीप इत्याहुराचारो धर्मसाधकः। ज्ञानं वै परमं विद्यात् संन्यासं नृप उत्तमम्॥
en: Penance, it has been said, is light. Conduct leads to piety. Knowledge is said to be the highest. Renunciation is the best penance.

sa: तेन तस्याभवत् प्रीतो वृत्तेन स नराधिपः॥ अन्वतप्यत संस्मृत्य पुत्रं तं मन्दचेतसम्।
en: The old king became highly pleased with such conduct of Yudhishthira. Indeed, he was grieved at the remembrance of his own wicked son.

sa: प्रसादे चैव सत्त्वस्य प्रसादं समवाप्नुयात्। लक्षणं हि प्रसादस्य यथा स्यात् स्वप्नदर्शनम्॥
en: Upon the understanding becoming clear, he succeeds in acquiring tranquillity. The mark of tranquillity is like that what takes place in a dream.

sa: प्रविष्टा इव शोकेन नाभ्यनन्दन्त किञ्चन। सम्भाष्यमाणा अपि ते न किञ्चित् प्रत्यपूजयन्॥
en: Stricken with deep sorrow, they could not find pleasure from anything. It any body asked them, they never honored him with an answer.

sa: एवं धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥ भ्रातृभिः सहितो धीमान् पूजयामास तं नृपम्।
en: Thus did that foremost of righteous men, viz., king Yudhishthira the just, endued with great intelligence, along with his brothers, adored king Dhritarashtra.

sa: वसुभिर्वसुधापाल गङ्गया च महामते॥ पुरा हि श्रुतमेतत् ते वसुभिः कथितं मया।
en: Formerly, o king, I heard this said by the Vasus while they were in the company of Ganga, O you of great intelligence.

sa: तस्मात् तडागं कुर्वीत आरामांश्चैव रोपयेत् यजेच्च विविधैर्यज्ञैः सत्यं च सततं वदेत्॥
en: Hence, one should cause tanks to be excavated and trees to be planted, adore the deities in diverse sacrifices, and speak the truth.

sa: अन्यान् बाणान् समीक्षस्व यैस्त्वं मां सूदयिष्यसि। तच्छुत्वा स विचिन्त्याथ ततो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Do you then look for other arrows with which to kill me! Hearing these words and thinking upon them, he said as follows.

sa: तं वै संयुज्य शापेन मण्डूकं त्वरितो ययौ। अन्यत्र वासाय विभुर्न चात्मानमदर्शयत्॥
en: Having made this curse on the frog, he left spot immediately for living else, where. Indeed the powerful celestial did not show himself.

sa: पृथक्त्वेन हि भूतानां विषया वै गुणाः स्मृताः॥ बीजधर्मं तथाव्यक्तं प्रसवात्मकमेव च।
en: And from the great elements respectively, the objects of sense proceed. The unmanifest is of the nature of seed. It produced its essence.

sa: पुष्पैः सुरगणान् वृक्षाः फलैचापि तथा पितॄन्। छायया चातिथिं तात पूजयन्ति महीरुहः॥
en: Trees please the deities by their flowers; the Departed Manes by their fruits; and all guests and strangers by the shadow they afford.

sa: च्यवनो जमदग्निश्च वसिष्ठो गौतमो भृगुः। सर्व एव दिवं प्राप्ताः क्षमावन्तो महर्षयः॥
en: Chyavana, Jamadagni, Vasishtha, Gautama and Bhriguall these great Rishis gifted with the virtue of forgivenesshave attained to Heaven through the observance of fasts.

sa: त्वं हि केशव धर्मात्मा सत्यवान् सत्यविक्रमः। स तां वाचमृतां कर्तुमर्हसि त्वमरिंदम॥
en: You, O Keshava, are righteous-souled, truthful, and of prowess incapable of being baffled. You should, O chastiser of enemies make your words truthful.

sa: मोहादधर्मं यः कृत्वा पुनः समनुतप्यते। मन:समाधिसंयुक्तो न स सेवेते दुष्कृतम्॥ यथा यथा मनस्तस्य दुष्कृतं कर्म गर्हते। तथा तथा शरीर तु तेनाधर्मेण मुच्यते॥
en: That man who having perpetrated sinful deeds through stupefaction of mind, feels the pangs of repentance and sets his heart on meditation (of the deity), has not to suffer the consequences of his sins. One becomes freed from his sins inasmuch as he repents for them.

sa: ततो ययुः पाण्डुसुता ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्ति वाच्य च। अर्चयित्वा सुरश्रेष्ठं पूर्वमेव महेश्वरम्॥
en: Making the Brahmanas utter benedictions on them, and having duly adored the great god Maheshvara, the sons of Pandu started on their enterprise).

sa: ते चैवान्ये पृथक् सर्वे तीर्थेष्वाप्लुत्य भारत। चक्रुः सर्वाः क्रियास्तत्र पुरुषा विदुरादयः॥
en: The king and the queen, and Vidura and others, O Bharata, having bathed in the sacred river, performed the usual rites of religion.

sa: अन्नदस्य मनुष्यस्य बलमोजो यशांसि च। कीर्तिश्च वर्धते शश्वत् त्रिषु लोकेषु पार्थिव॥
en: The strength, energy, fame and achievements of the man who makes gifts of food, always multiply themselves in the three worlds, O king.

sa: त्वं तु प्रत्यक्षदर्शी च रूपज्ञश्च महाभुजा तस्मात् प्रब्रूहि संग्रामं याथातथ्येन मेऽनघ॥
en: You however, O mighty-armed one, have seen it with your own eyes. Do you, therefore, O sinless one, describe the battle in full.

sa: यतः प्राणभृतां प्राणा: सम्भवन्ति विशाम्पते॥ देवानाममृतं ह्यन्नं नागानां च सुधा तथा।
en: From these, O king, the vital airs of all living creatures flow. The deities have nectar for their food. The Nagas have Sudha.

sa: एतद् रूपमुदानस्य परमं ब्राह्मणा विदुः। निर्द्वन्द्वमिति यत् त्वेतत् तन्मे निगदतः शृणु॥
en: That is the excellent form (or seat) of Udana, as the Brahmanas know. Listen as I say which is distinct from the pairs.

sa: विश्वेदेवाश्च ये नित्यं पितृभिः सह गोचराः। तेभ्यः संकल्पिता भागाः स्वयमेव स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: The Self Create next ordained a portion of the offerings to the Vishvedevas also, who are always the companions of the departed Manes.

sa: न च प्रेत्य विनश्यन्ति गच्छन्ति च परां गतिम्। येन येनैव हविषा ब्राह्मणांस्तर्पयेन्नरः॥ तेन तेनैव प्रीयन्ते पितरो देवतास्तथा। ब्राह्मणादेव तद् भूतं प्रभवन्ति यतः प्रजाः॥
en: Such men never meet with destruction. Indeed, they succeed in acquiring great ends. Those particular offerings in sacrifices with which one pleases the Brahmanas, go to please both the departed manes and the deities. The Brahmana is the cause of that sacrifice whence all created things have originated.

sa: स्निग्धगम्भीरया वाचा भार्गवः सुप्रसन्नया। ददानि वां वरं श्रेष्ठं तं ब्रूतामिति भारत॥
en: Indeed the son of Bhrigu, in a soft, deep, and delighted voice, saidI am ready to give an excellent boon to you both.

sa: पुष्येण कनकं दत्त्वा कृतं वाकृतमेव च। अनालोकेषु लोकेषु सोमवत् स विराजते॥
en: Making a gift of wrought or unwrought gold, under the constellation Pushya, one shines like the Moon himself in regions of surrounding darkness.

sa: अन्यान् बाणान् समीक्षस्व यैस्त्वं मां सूदयिष्यसि। तच्छुत्वा स विचिन्त्याथ ततो वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Do you then look for other arrows with which to kill me! Hearing these words and reflecting upon them, he said as follows.

sa: अद्रोहः सर्वभूतेषु संतोषः शीलमार्जवम्। तपो दमश्च सत्यं च प्रदानं चेति सम्मितम्॥
en: Abstention from injury to all creatures, contentment, conduct, sincerity, penances, selfcontrol, truthfulness, and gifts, are each equal in point of merit to sacrifice.

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं सुवर्णस्य महीपते। प्रदानस्य फलं चैव जन्म चास्य युधिष्ठिर॥
en: I have thus, told you, O king, everything about the merits of the gifts of gold and about its origin also, O Yudhishthira.

sa: स तं जित्वा महाराज नैषादि पाकशासनिः। अर्चितः प्रययौ भूयो दक्षिणं सलिलार्णवम्॥
en: Having subjugated the son of Ekalavya, O king, the son of Indra, duly adored by the Nishadas, then proceeded towards the southern Ocean.

sa: यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा तु बहवो राजानो द्विजसत्तमाः। इह कीर्ति परां प्राप्य प्रेत्य स्वर्गमवाप्नुयुः॥
en: Numberless kings, O best of twice-born persons, having adored the celestials in sacrifices, acquired high fame here and obtained the celestial region hercafter.

sa: अथ शून्येन मनसा प्रविश्य स्वगृहं नृपः। ददर्श शयने तस्मिन् शयानं भृगुनन्दनम्।॥
en: With a despairing heart he then went to his room. There he beheld the son of Bhrigu stretched as before on his bed.

sa: ब्रह्मचर्येण दानेन यज्ञेन तपसा तथा॥ असंकरेण धर्मेण तस्माद् गच्छ दिवं द्विज।
en: For your Brahmacharya, your gifts, your sacrifices, your penances, and your acts of piety done with a pure heart, go you to Heaven.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच विजिते पाण्डवेयैस्तु प्रशान्ते च द्विजोत्तम। राष्ट्रे किं चक्रतुर्वीरौ वासुदेवधनंजयौ॥
en: O best of the twice-borns, when the Pandavas had reconquered and pacified their kingdom, what did the two warriors Vasudeva and Dhananjaya do?

sa: सोऽयं नारायणः श्रीमान् दीप्त्या परमया युतः। व्रतं यथावत् तच्चीवा॑ द्वारकां पुनरागमत्॥
en: As regards Narayana, who is gifted with prosperity and blazing effulgence, He returned to Dwaraka after having duly observed that vow of His.

sa: राजतं भाजनं हृत्वा कपोतः सम्प्रजायते। हृत्वा तु काञ्चनं भाण्डं कृमियोनौ प्रजायते॥
en: By stealing a silver vessel, one becomes a pigeon. By stealing a golden vessel, one has to take birth as a vile veriin.

sa: त्रिधा दानानि दीयन्ते त्रिधा यज्ञः प्रवर्तते। त्रिधा लोकास्त्रिधा देवास्त्रिधा विद्यास्त्रिधा गतिः।।१९
en: The gifts are threefold. Threefold is sacrifice. Threefold are the worlds; threefold the celestials; threefold is knowledge; and threefold the path or end.

sa: पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रं च ब्रह्मलोके महीयते॥ तत्क्षयादिह चागम्य माहाम्यं प्रतिपद्यते। यस्तु संवत्सरं पूर्णमेकाहारो भवेन्नरः॥ अतिरात्रस्य यज्ञस्य स फलं समुपाश्नुते। दशवर्षसहस्राणि स्वर्गे च स महीयते॥
en: After the exhaustion of that merit, such a person returns to Earth and acquires elevated position. That man who passes one whole year, taking himself every day only one meal, acquires the merit of the Atiratra sacrifice. He ascends to Heaven after death and receives great honours there.

sa: मम कौतूहलं त्वस्ति तेष्वर्थेषु पुनः पुनः। भवांस्तु द्वारकां गन्ता नचिरादिव माधव॥
en: However, I have been curious again and again on the subject of those truths. You, too, O Madhava, will go to Dwraka soon.

sa: उपावृत्तेषु पार्थेषु सर्वास्वेव वधूषु च। ययौ राजा महाप्राज्ञो धृतराष्ट्रो वनं तदा॥
en: After all the sons of Pritha and all the ladies had returned homewards, the highly wise king Yudhishthira his journey to the forest.

sa: शब्दस्पर्शी रूपरसौ गन्धो वाक्यं क्रिया गतिः। रेतोमूत्रपुरीषाणां त्यागो दश हवींषि च॥
en: Sound, touch, colour, taste, scent, speech, action, motion, and the discharge of vital seed, of urine, and of cxcreta, are the ten libations.

sa: न च सा वनवासाय देवी कृतमति तदा। शक्नोत्युपावर्तयितुं कुन्ती धर्मपरां सतीम्॥
en: She, however, could not make Kunti to desist inasmuch as that chaste lady, devoted to virtue, had determined upon living in the forest.

sa: एतस्मात् कारणाद् ब्रह्मश्चिरायैतत् कृतं मया। एतच्छ्रुत्वा मम विभो मा क्रुधस्त्वं तपोधन॥
en: with me. This . has been the cause of the delay! Informed of the cause, do you, O lord, cease to be angry

sa: वृत्ते स्वयंवरे चैव राजानः सव्र एव ते। यथागतं विप्रजग्मुर्विदित्वा पाण्डवान् वृतान्॥
en: When the Svyaimvara was over, all the kings, learning that Draupadi had been wedding to the Pandavas, went away to therefore respective kings.

sa: येन लिङ्गेन यो देशो युक्तः समुपलक्ष्यते। तेनैव नाम्ना तं देशं वाच्यमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: The wise men have said that every place should be known by a name significant of something which may have made it famous.

sa: राम उवाच शरीरमात्रमेवाद्य मया समवशेषितम्। अस्त्राणि वा शरीरं वा ब्रह्मन्नेकतमं वृणु॥
en: Rama said: O Brahmana, after giving away all I have now left only my body. Ask from me either my body or weapons.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच एवमुक्तस्तथा पार्थ विश्वामित्रो बलादिव॥ हंसचन्द्रप्रतीकाशां नन्दिनीं तां जहार गाम्।
en: The Gandharva said: O Partha, having been thus addressed, Vishvamitra then sized the cow Nandini as white as the swan or the moon.

sa: एवं चक्रुरिमां सर्वे वशे कृत्स्नां वसुंधराम्। पञ्चभिः सूर्यसंकाशैः सूर्येण च विराजता॥
en: Having done this their kingdom extended over the whole world. Each like a sun in splendour, they looked like five suns; some reasons

sa: एवं ज्ञात्वा विजानीहि यद् ब्रवीमि तपोधन। व्रतस्थे नियमोपेत यथा वर्ताम्यहं त्वयि॥
en: O great ascetic, knowing this, hear what I say. You are aware of my behaviour towards you during the period of your vow.

sa: तेभ्यः प्राचेतसो जज्ञे दक्षो दक्षादिमाः प्रजाः। सम्भूताः पुरुषव्याघ्र स हि लोकपितामहः॥
en: O lion among the men, from them was born Prachetas Daksha and from Daksha sprang all creatures. Therefore, he was called the Grandsire.

sa: मेनकोवाच महातेजाः स भगवांस्तथैव च महातपाः। कोपनश्च तथा ह्येनं जानाति भगवानपि॥
en: Menaka said: That illustrious Rishi, is a great ascetic and is greatly effulgent; your illustrious self known also that he is very wrathful.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच विभीषका वै गन्धर्व नास्त्रज्ञेषु प्रयुज्यते। अस्त्रज्ञेषु प्रयुक्तेयं फेनवत् प्रविलीयते॥
en: Arjuna said : O Gandharva, seek not to terrify those who are skilled in weapons, for weapons hurled at them vanish like froth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अथ दीर्घस्य कालस्य तपोवनचरो नृपः। सभार्यः स्वर्गमगमत् तपस्तप्त्वा बृहद्रथः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having lived for a long time in the forest and practiced asceticism, (the king) Brihadratha ascended to heaven with his wives.

sa: गन्धर्व उवाच हन्त तं कथयिष्यामि कथामेतां मनोरमाम्। यथावदखिलां पार्थ सर्वबुद्धिमतां वर॥
en: The Gandharva said : O Partha, o foremost of all intelligent men, I shall duly narrate to you in detail this interesting story.

sa: हलायुधस्तत्र जनार्दनश्च वृष्ण्यन्धकाश्चैव यथाप्रधानम्। प्रेक्षां स्म चक्रुर्यदुपुङ्गवास्ते स्थिताश्च कृष्णस्य मते महान्तः॥
en: Halayudha, (Balarama) Janardana (Krishna), the chiefs of Vrishni, Andhaka and Yadava tribes, all ever obedient to Krishna, were also there viewing the scene.

sa: सा गौस्तत् सकलं सैन्यं कालयामास दूरतः। विश्वामित्रस्य तत् सैन्यं काल्यमानं त्रियोजनम्॥
en: That cow (Nandini) simply drove the troops (of Vishvamitra) to a distance. Being thus driven full seventy seven miles, the troops of Vishvamitra,

sa: वासुदेव उवाच पतितौ हंसडिम्भकौ कंसश्च सगणो हतः। जरासंधस्य निधने कालोऽयं समुपागतः॥
en: Krishna said Hansa and Dimbhaka have fallen Kansa also with his followers has been killed; the time has, therefore, come for killing Jarasandha.

sa: मन्दपाल उवाच युष्माकमपवर्गार्थं विज्ञप्तो ज्वलनो मया। अग्निना च तथेत्येवं प्रतिज्ञातं महात्मना॥
en: Mandapala said : I spoke to Agni about your safety, the illustrious deity also promised me that he would do what I wished.

sa: तां शरैराचितां दृष्ट्वा नदीं गङ्गां तदन्तिके। अभवद् विस्मितो राजा दृष्ट्वा कर्मातिमानुषम्॥
en: The king, seeing this wonderful feat (of the youth), namely the checking of Ganga in her course by arrows, was very much surprised.

sa: पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु पुनर्दास्यामि यौवनम्। स्वं चैव प्रतिपत्स्यामि पाप्मानं जरया सह॥
en: After the expiration of one thousand years, I shall return, to you, your youth and take back my decrepitude and its consequent weakness.

sa: नावहास्या भविष्यामो न च लाघवमास्थिताः। न च विद्विष्टतां लोके गमिष्यामो महीक्षिताम्॥
en: The Brahmana said: We shall not be ridiculous, nor shall we incur the disrespect of any body, or the displeasure of the sovereigns.
