sa: तं दृष्ट्वा दुपदः प्रीतो बभूव रिपुसूदनः। सह सैन्यैश्च पार्थस्य साहाय्यार्थमियेष सः॥
en: Seeing him (Arjuna), that chastiser of foes, Draupada, became exceedingly glad and he desired to assist Partha with his army in occasion arose.

sa: तत् प्रगृह्य धनं सर्वं शल्यः सम्प्रीतमानसः। ददौ तां समलंकृत्य स्वसारं कौरवर्षभे॥
en: Salya receive all these wealth in delightful health and gave away his sister decked with ornaments, to that lion of the Kuru race.

sa: सौतिरुवाच भस्मीभूतं ततो वृक्षं पन्नगेन्द्रस्य तेजसा। भस्म सर्वं समाहृत्य काश्यपो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: The tree was reduced to ashes by the poison of the king of snakes. But taking up the ashes, Kashyapa spoke these words.

sa: शुक्र उवाच संक्रामयिष्यसि जरां यथेष्टं नहुषात्मज। मामनुध्याय भावेन न च पापमवाप्स्यसि॥ वयो दास्यति ते पुत्रो यः स राजा भविष्यति। आयुष्मान् कीर्तिमांश्चैव बह्वपत्यस्तथैव च॥
en: Shukra said: O son of Nahusha, remembering me you will be able to transfer your this decrepitude to whomever you like. Your that son who will give you his youth will become your successor on the throne. He will have long life, widespread fame and a large progeny.

sa: देहमन्यं गतायास्ते यथोक्तं तद् भविष्यति। दुपदस्य कुले जज्ञे सा कन्या देवरूपिणी॥
en: Therefore, you will have in another life, what I have said now.” That celestials like girl was born in the race of Drupada.

sa: विवस्वतो वै देवस्य सावित्र्यवरजा विभो। विश्रुता त्रिषु लोकेषु तपती तपसा युता॥
en: That daughter of the Vivasvata (Tapati) was the younger sister of Savitri. She was celebrated in the three worlds and devoted to asceticism.

sa: इमामपि च ते बालामनाथां परिभूय माम्। अनर्हाः प्रार्थयिष्यन्ति शूद्रा वेदश्रुति यथा।॥
en: When I shall be in such helpless state, the unworthy persons will demand this orphan girl, like Shudras desiring to hear the Vedas.

sa: अतो रात्रौ प्राप्नुवन्तो जलं ब्रह्मविदो जनाः। गर्हयन्ति नरान् सर्वान् बलस्थान् नृपतीनपि॥
en: Stay at a distance. Do not come near me. Know you not that I am (now) bathing in the waters of the Bhagirathi.

sa: शोचते चैव कारुण्याच्छुणु ये वै वयं द्विजा यायावरा नाम वयमृषयः संशितव्रताः॥
en: Hear, O Brahmana, who we are and for whom you are lamenting. We are Rishis of the name of Yayavara of rigid vows.

sa: ततः सुमन्त्रस्त्वागम्य राघवं वाक्यमब्रवीत्। एते प्रतिहता राजन्द्वारि तिष्ठन्ति तापसाः॥ भार्गवं च्यवनं चैव पुरस्कृत्य महर्षयः। दर्शनं ते महाराज चोदयन्ति कृतत्वराः॥ प्रीयमाणा नरव्याघ्र यमुनातीरवासिनः। तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा रामः प्रोवाच धर्मवित्॥ प्रवेश्यन्तां महाभागा भार्गवप्रमुखा द्विजाः।
en: At this time Sumantra, entering, addressed him, saying, “O king, stopped at the gate, some ascetic stay there, Maharsis, led by Bhargava and Cyavana. And, O mighty monarch, eager for a sight of you, those dwellers on the banks of the Yamunā, well pleased, have despatched me (hither), O tiger among men.” Hearing his words, the righteous Rāma answered: “Let the exalted Brāhmaṇas leaded by Bhārgava, enter."

sa: तस्य बुद्धिः समुत्पन्ना निवेश्य मधुरां पुरीम्। रामपादौ निरीक्षेऽहं वर्षे द्वादश आगते॥
en: Having thus reared the beautiful city he resolved within himself The twelfth year has come. I shall now behold the feet of Rāma.

sa: दशवर्षसहस्राणि वाजिमेधानथाकरोत्। वाजपेयान्दशगुणांस्तथा बहुसुवर्णकान्।।।। अग्निष्टोमातिरावाभ्यां गोसवैश्च महाधनैः। ईजे क्रतुभिरन्यैश्च स श्रीमानाप्तदक्षिणैः॥
en: In this wise for thousand years he celebrated many Horse-sacrifices, many Vajapeyas with profuse gold, Agnistomas, Atiratras, numberless Gomedhas and various other sacrifices.

sa: प्रत्युत्थाय तदा कृष्णा स्वसारं माधवस्य च॥ परिष्वज्यावदत् प्रीत्या निःसपत्नोऽस्तु ते पतिः।
en: Krishna hastily rose and embraced the sister of Madhava; and out of affection she then said, “Let you husband be without a rival."

sa: ययातिरुवाच अधर्मो न स्पृशेदेष महान् मामिह भार्गव। वर्णसंकरजो ब्रह्मन्निति त्वां प्रवृणोम्यहम्॥
en: Yayati said : O Brahmana, I solicit the boon by which the sin of my begetting a mixed caste may not touch me.

sa: शोकबुद्धिं तदा चक्रे न चैकत्र व्यतिष्ठत। सोऽगच्छत पर्वतांश्चैव सरितश्च संरासि च॥
en: Being oppressed with grief, that Rishi could not from that time stay at one place. He went to the mountains, rivers and lakes.

sa: पाण्डुरुवाच एवमेतत् पुरा कुन्ति व्युषिताश्वश्चकार ह। यथा त्वयोक्तं कल्याणि स ह्यासीदमरोपमः॥
en: Pandu said: O Kunti, what you have said is true. Vyushitashva of old did exactly as you said; he was like a celestial.

sa: तत् तथा भविता भद्रे वचस्तद् भद्रमस्तु ते। देहमन्यं गतायास्ते सर्वमेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: O amiable girl, therefore it shall be as you have asked. Be blessed. All this will happen in one of your future births.”

sa: पृष्टश्च कुशलं तेन रामेण वदतां वरः। आसने काश्चने दिव्ये निषसाद महायशाः॥
en: Being asked by Rāma as to his welfare, that foremost of ascetics, skilled in the are of speech, sat on a golden seat.

sa: प्रज्ञया वयसा चैव वृद्धः कीर्त्या नयेन च। अमात्यस्तं समुत्थाप्य बभूव विगतज्वरः॥
en: Old the wisdom as in age and in achievements as in policy, the minister became easy of mind when he raised him up.

sa: प्रतिनन्द्य स तां पूजां पृष्ट्वा कुशलमन्ततः। आसने काञ्चने शुद्धे निषसाद महामनाः॥
en: The high-souled (Rishi) saluted them in return and inquired after their welfare; he then sat down on a holy carpet made of gold.

sa: बभ्रुवाहननाम्ना तु मम प्राणो महीचरः। तस्माद् भरस्व पुत्रं वै पुरुषं वंशवर्धनम्॥
en: I am leaving on earth only because of Babhruvahana's name. Therefore, you should bring up this child who is spreader of our dynasty.

sa: गच्छाम्यहं तं त्वरित: सद्यः कर्तुमपज्वरम्। मयाऽभिपन्नं तं चापि न सर्पो धर्षयिष्यति॥
en: I am going in a hurry to cure him, so that he, being treated by me, may not he killed by the snake.

sa: सोऽहं त्वयेह विजित: संख्ये तापत्यवर्धन। येन तेनेह विधिना कीर्त्यमानं निबोध मे॥
en: O best of all vow-observing men, I was vanquished by you in battle; hear from me the reasons for with I was discomfited.

sa: यदा च वो ग्राहभूता गृहणन्तीः पुरुषाञ्जले। उत्कर्षति जलात् तस्मात् स्थलं पुरुषसत्तमः॥ तदा यूयं पुनः सर्वाः स्वं रूपं प्रतिपत्स्यथ। अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे हसतापि कदाचन॥
en: You shall, becoming crocodiles, seize and drag men into water. (After the expiration of one hundred years), a best of men will drag you all from the water to the land. You will then resume your own real forms. I have never spoken an untruth even in jest.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अथ तत्रोपविष्टेषु पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु। महत्सु चोपविष्टेषु गन्धर्वेषु च भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said O descendant of Bharata, when the illustrious Pandavas were seated in it (their assembly-hall) with the chief Gandharvas, there came Narada,

sa: भीष्म उवाच गुणैः समुदितं सम्यगिदं नः प्रथितं कुलम्। अत्यन्यान् पृथिवीपालान् पृविव्यामधिराज्यभाक्॥
en: Bhishma said : This our famous dynasty, endued with every virtue and accomplishment, has all along ruled over all other kings on earth.

sa: सा वै तस्याभवन्माता पिता चैवेति नः श्रुतम्। त्रयोदश समुद्रस्य द्वीपानश्नन् पुरूरवाः॥
en: We have heard that Ila was both the father and the mother of Pururava. He had sway over thirteen islands of the sea.

sa: जरितारिरुवाच पुरतः कृच्छ्रकालस्य धीमाञ्जागर्ति पूरुषः। स कृच्छ्रकालं सम्प्राप्य व्यथां नैवैति कर्हिचित्॥
en: Jaritari said : The intelligent men always remain wakeful in view of death. When the house of death approaches, he feels no pangs.

sa: इत्युक्तः स तदा तेन ददानीत्येव निश्चितः। प्रत्यभाषत तं विप्रं प्रतिनन्द्य दिवाकरः॥
en: The Gandharva said : Having been thus addressed, Divakara (Surya) resolved upon bestowing (his daughter on Samvarana) and saluting the Rishi thus replied,

sa: भीम मा भैर्महाबाहो न त्वां बुध्यामहे वयम्। समेतं भीमरूपेण रक्षसा श्रमकर्शितम्॥
en: "O Bhima, O mighty armed (hero) fear nothing. we did not know that in the fight with the terrible Rakshasas you are tired.

sa: कथं धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठः सुतो धर्मस्य धर्मवित्। अनर्हः परमं क्लेशं सोढवान्स युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Why did Yudhishthira, the best of all virtuous men and the son of Dharma himself, though acquainted with all duties, suffer great afflictions?

sa: ततो जानपदीं नाम देवकन्यां सुरेश्वरः। प्राहिणोत् तपसो विनं कुरु तस्येति कौरव॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, the king of the celestial summoned a celestial maiden named Janapadi and told her, “Destroy the penances (of Sharadvata).

sa: हिडिम्बोवाच यदेतत् पश्यसि वनं नीलमेघनिभं महत्। निवासो राक्षसस्यैष हिडिम्बस्य ममैव च॥
en: Hidimba said: The blue cloud like great forest that you see is the abode of mine and that of my brother, Rakshasas Hidimba.

sa: अयं स कालः संप्राप्तो यदर्थमसि मे स्वसः। जरत्कारी मया दत्ता त्रायस्वास्मान्सबान्धवान्॥
en: That time has come, O sister, for which I bestowed you on the Rishi Jaratkaru; O sister, protect us with all our race.

sa: स नः प्रक्ष्यति सर्वेषु कार्येष्वर्थविनिश्चयम्। तत्र बुद्धिं प्रदास्यामो यथा यज्ञो निवर्त्यति॥
en: He will then certainly ask our advice in all things and we shall then give him such advice as may obstruct the sacrifice.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्थिवेन्द्रस्य रक्षसा विकृतं च तत्। पुनः प्रोवाच राजानं वसिष्ठः पुरुषर्षभम्॥ मया रोषपरीतेन यदिदं व्याहृतं वचः। नैतच्छक्यं वृथा कर्तुं प्रदास्यामि च ते वरम्॥ कालो द्वादश वर्षाणि शापस्यान्तो भविष्यति। मत्प्रासादाच्च राजेन्द्र अतीतं न स्मरिष्यसि॥
en: Hearing the words of the king and being apprised that this wife vile act had been done by the Rākşasa, Vasiștha said, “O king, even what I have said angrily shall not prove futile. However I confer upon you this boon that after twelve years you shall be freed from this curse, and by my favour you shall cherish no recollection of your condition extending ever those twelve years."

sa: स्रुग्भाण्डं निशि गत्वा च अपरे भुजगोत्तमाः। प्रमत्तानां हरन्त्वाशु विघ्न एवं भविष्यति॥
en: Other good snakes said, “Let us go in the night and steal away the vessel of the Soma. This will obstruct the sacrifice.

sa: पृथिवी रत्नसम्पूर्णा हिरण्यं पशवः स्त्रियः। नालमेकस्य तत् सर्वमिति मत्वा शमं व्रजेत्॥
en: Even if one enjoys the whole earth, with its wealth, its diamonds, gold, aniimals and women, still his desires will not be satiated.

sa: निर्जने तु वने यस्माच्छकुन्तैः परिवारिता। शकुन्तलेति नामास्याः कृतं चापि ततो मया॥
en: Because she was found in the solitude of the forest, protected by the Shakuntas (birds), she has been named Shakuntala (protected by birds.)

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ते परस्परममन्त्र्य देवकल्पा महर्षयः। पाण्डोः पुत्रान् पुरस्कृत्य नगरं नागसाह्वयम्॥ उदारमनसः सिद्धा गमने चक्रिरे मनः। भीष्माय पाण्डवान् दातुं धृतराष्ट्राय चैव हि॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus consulting with one another those god like Rishis of magnanimous hearts and of ascetic success resolved to go to the city of Hastinapur with the sons of Pandu in their front and to place them in the hands of Dhritarashtra and Bhishma.

sa: आजगाम ततो देवो धर्मो मन्त्रबलात् ततः। विमाने सूर्यसंकाशे कुन्ती यत्र जपस्थिता॥
en: The deity Dharma, being overpowered by the Mantra, came on his car resplendent as the sun to the place where Kunti was seated.

sa: तर्पयित्वा द्विजश्रेष्ठान् पायसेन सहस्रशः। धनं बहुविधं दत्त्वा तेभ्य एव च वीर्यवान्॥
en: That greatly powerful (Danava) gratified thousands of excellent Brahmanas with Payasa (sweetened milk and rice) and with presents of various kinds of wealth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच संवत्सरधृते गर्भे गान्धार्या जनमेजय। आह्वयामास वै कुन्ती गभार्थे धर्ममच्युतम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O Janamejaya, when Gandhari was pregnant for a year, it was then that Kunti called the eternal Dharma for offspring.

sa: प्रीतिश्चास्मिन्परा जाता देवानां लवणे हते। भूतानां चैव सर्वेषां जगतश्च प्रियं कृतम्॥
en: Lavaņa being slain, the celestials have been greatly delighted-what more the well-being of the whole universe and all creatures has been brought about.

sa: जरासन्धबलं प्राप्य दुष्पारं भीमविक्रमम्। यमोऽपि न विजेताऽऽजौ तत्र वः किं विचेष्टितम्॥
en: Even Yama cannot defeat the powerful army of Jarasandha who himself is endued with terrible velour. What velour can you show against him?

sa: शौनक उवाच सर्पसत्रे तदा राज्ञः पाण्डवेयस्य धीमतः। जनमेजयस्य के त्वासऋत्विजः परमर्षयः॥
en: Shaunaka said: Who were the great Rishis that became the Ritvijas in the Snake-sacrifice of the wise king Janamejaya of the Pandava dynasty?

sa: ततो यज्ञे समाप्ते तु भृगुस्तत्रेदमब्रवीत्। आनयिष्यामि ते चेतस्तुष्टोऽस्मि तव पार्थिव ॥
en: There upon at the end of the sacrifice Bhrgu said O king, I am propitiated with you; I shall restore you to senses.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच किंनिमित्तमभूद वैरं विश्वामित्रवसिष्ठयोः। वसतोराश्रमे दिव्ये शंस नः सर्वमेव तत्॥
en: Arjuna said: How the hostility between Vishvamitra and Vasishtha, both of whom lived in celestials hermitages? Tell us all this in detail. arose

sa: अथ दुर्योधनो राजा विमना भ्रातृभिः सह। अश्वत्थाम्ना मातुलेन कर्णेन च कृपेण च॥ विनिवृत्तो वृतं दृष्ट्वा द्रौपद्या श्वेतवाहनम्। तं तु दुःशासनो वीडन मन्दं मन्दमिवाब्रवीत्॥
en: Having heard that Draupadi had been married to the rider of the white horse (Arjuna), Duryodhana, became greatly depressed; and accompanied by his brothers,। Ashvathama, his maternal uncle (Shakuni), Karna and Kripa, he started for his capital. Then Dushashana, being full of shame, thus slowly spoke to him.

sa: व्यास उवाच कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च यथा भेदोऽभवत्पुरा। तदस्मै सर्वमाचक्ष्व यन्मत्तः श्रुतवानसि॥
en: Vyasa said : Repeat, exactly as you heard from me the account of the quarrel between the Kurus and the Pandavas of old.

sa: एतया वर्तमानस्य बुद्ध्या राष्ट्रं न सीदति। विजित्य च महीं राजा सोऽत्यन्तसुखमेधते॥
en: He who conducts himself thus never finds his kingdom distressed or afflicted. Such a king subjugates the whole earth and enjoys great happiness.

sa: यत् त्वस्य सहजं राजन् पितृपैतामहं बलम्। अभिजातबलं नाम तच्चतुर्थं बलं स्मृतम्॥
en: What strength is acquired from one's father and grandfather, the strength of birth, the holy books declare, is the fourth sort of strength.

sa: अथ ये नैव कुर्वन्ति नैव जातु भवन्ति ते। ऐकगुण्यमनीहायामभावः कर्मणां फलम्॥
en: To those who do not make any attempt success does not come in the absence of exertion; there is only result of actions.

sa: यदा प्रहृष्टः सम्राट् त्वां संयोधयति कुवारैः। हसन्त्यन्तःपुरे नार्यो मम तूद्विजते मनः॥
en: When the monarch in joy makes you fight with elephants and the women of his seraglio laugh my mind totally sinks in sorrow.

sa: नर इन्द्रस्य संग्रामे हत्वा शत्रून् परन्तपः। पौलोमान् कालखमांश्च सहस्राणि शतानि च॥
en: That excellent among the ascetics, Nara, having killed the enemies in the battle for Indra, (killed) hundred and thousands of Paulomas and Kalakhanjas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शासनाद् धृतराष्ट्रस्य दुर्योधनममर्षणम्। मातुश्च वचनात् क्षत्ता सभां प्रावेशयत् पुनः॥
en: Vaishampayana said By command of Dhritarashtra as also at the request of the mother the Kshattri again had the wrathful Duryodhana brought there.

sa: समेत्य च महाबाहुः शल्यः पाण्डुसेतैस्तदा। पाद्यमयं च गां चैव प्रत्यगृह्णाद् यथाविधि॥
en: And having come there, he, the long armed one accepted the customary water for washing his feet and other gifts including a cow.

sa: तमब्रुवन् पुनः सर्वे देवा ऋषिपुरोगमाः। अस्माकं तपसा युक्तः पाहि राज्यं त्रिविष्टपे॥
en: All the gods and the foremost among the Rishis said to him, Endued with the virtue of devotion, protect our kingdom in heaven.

sa: विष्णुरुवाच अवश्यं करणीयं मे भवतां हितमुत्तमम्। तस्मादुपायं वक्ष्यामि यथाऽसौ न भविष्यति॥
en: Vishnu said Doing your good is my imperative duty; therefore am I speaking of the means by which he shall cease to exist.

sa: प्रत्याजहार तां रामः सुग्रीवबलमाश्रितः। बद्ध्वा सेतुं समुद्रस्य दग्ध्वा लङ्कां शितैः शरैः॥
en: Constructing a bridge over the ocean and burn in down Lanka with sharp shafts, by the help of Sugriva, Rama brought her back.

sa: यश्च सर्वान् वशे चक्रे लोकपालान् धनुर्धरः। तेन वो विजयेनाजौ पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत।॥
en: That wielder of the bow, who subjugated all the rulers of the earth by the aid of that Vijaya will the Pandavas fight.

sa: न रथानां न चाश्वानां न गजानां न वर्मणाम्। अनिविद्धं शितैर्बाणैरासीद द्वयङ्गुलमन्तरम्॥
en: Of the chariots, horses, elephants and coats of mail there was not space measuring even two fingers that was nor pierced with shafts.

sa: भार्या मे भव सुश्रोणि त्यजैनान् सुखमाप्नुहि। अखिलान् सिन्धुसौवीरानाप्नुहि त्वं मया सह॥
en: O you of beautiful hips, renouncing them, be happy by becoming my wife and share with me the kingdoms of Sindhu and Sauvira."

sa: सुकुमारी च बाला च राजपुत्री यशस्विनी। पतिव्रता महाभागा कथं नु विचरिष्यति॥
en: Tender and young is the king's daughter, endowed with eminence, devoted to her lords and highly virtuous; how will she pass her days?

sa: विराट उवाच उपपन्नं कुरुश्रेष्ठे कुन्तीपुत्र धनंजये। य एवं धर्मनित्यश्च जातज्ञानश्च पाण्डवः॥
en: Virata said It is indeed proper for the foremost of Kurus, Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, always virtuous and wise, to say this.

sa: लक्षणं चरितं चापि गवां यच्चापि मङ्गलम्। तत् सर्वं मे सुविदितमन्यच्चापि महीपते॥
en: 0 ruler of the earth, the nature, the characteristics and the favorable marks and other points regarding cows are well known to me.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच पुलस्त्यस्य तु यः क्रोधादर्धदेहोऽभवन्मुनिः। विश्रवा नाम सक्रोधः स वैश्रवणमैक्षत॥
en: Markandeya said : The ascetic Vishrava, who was begotten of the half body of Pulastya, with great anger began to look upon Vaishravana.

sa: आलोकयसि किं वृक्षं सूद दारुकृतेन वै। यदि ते दारुभिः कृत्यं बहिर्वक्षान्निगृह्यताम्॥
en: O cook, do you behold trees for fuel? If you are in need of faggots better gather them up from the trees abroad.

sa: उपासांचक्रिरे सर्वे कुरवो राजभिः सह। ततो दुर्योधनो राजा वार्ष्णेयं जयतां वरम्॥
en: All the people present including the Kuru kings, made worship. Then the king Duryodhana, that foremost of victors, the scion of Vrishni race.

sa: तान् परीप्सस्व राजेन्द्र मा नेशुः पशवस्तव। तच्छ्रुत्वा नृपतिः सेनां मत्स्यानां समयोजयत्।।९।
en: O king of kings, "rescue them speedily so that they may not be lost.” Hearing his words the king collected his Matsya, army.

sa: यथा सैरन्ध्रदोषेण न ते राजनिदं पुरम्। विनाशमेति वै क्षिप्रं तथा नीतिविधीयताम्॥
en: Soon find out some means O king, by which your kingdom may not be ruined on account of the injuries done to Sairandhri.'

sa: तत्र वासाय राष्ट्राणि कीर्तयिष्यामि कानिचित्। रमणीयानि गुप्तानि तेषां किञ्चित् स्म रोचया॥
en: from among But for purposes of our abode I shall mention some places some places both pleasant and sequestered, please fix upon those.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच जनार्दनवचः श्रुत्वा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। भ्रातृनुवाच धर्मात्मा समक्षं केशवस्य ह॥
en: Vaishampayana said The virtuous-souled king Yudhishthira the just, having heard these words of Janardana, said to his brothers in the presence of Keshava.

sa: कामक्रोधानुवर्ती हि यो मोहाद् विरुरुत्सति। गुणवन्तं च यो द्वेष्टि तमाहुः पुरुषाधमम्॥
en: He who following the dictates of impulse or wrath, owing to a confusion of the intellects, wants to act against the interests of.

sa: नाम वै वसुषेणेति कारयामास वै द्विजैः। भार्याश्चोढा मम प्राप्ते यौवने तत्परिचहात्॥
en: He had me named as Vasudeva by the twice born; on attaining my youth too did I marry wives according to his choice.

sa: अयं च बलिनां श्रेष्ठो भीमो भीमपराक्रमः। युवानौ च महेष्वासौ वीरौ माद्रवतीसुतौ॥
en: This Bhima of terrible prowess is the strongest of the strong; and the two youthful and heroic sons of Madravati are mighty bowmen.

sa: इन्द्रेण निषधान् प्राप्य गिरिप्रस्थाश्रमे तदा। छन्नेनोष्य कृतं कर्म द्विषतां च विनिग्रहे।॥
en: Indra for the purpose of defeating his enemies, dwelt in disguise in the asylum of Giriprastha in Nishadha and thus attained his end.

sa: तथा भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा विभीषणमुवाच ह। वरं वृष्णीष्व पुत्र त्वं प्रीतोऽस्मीति पुनः पुनः॥
en: Saying "So it shall be" he said to Vibhishana, “pray for a boon, O my son, I have been repeatedly pleased with you."

sa: न मे पापोऽस्त्यभिप्रायः पाण्डवान् प्रति केशव। ज्ञातमेव हितं वाक्य यन्मयोक्तः सुयोधनः॥
en: I have no wicked intention against the sons of Pandu, O Keshava; for the words I said to Suyodhana are known to you.

sa: सापतद् शतधा छिन्ना भूमौ पार्थेन धीमता॥ युगपच्चैव भल्लैस्तु ततः सज्यधनुः कृपः।
en: As soon as that fell on the ground sundered into a hundred pieces by the intelligent Partha, Kripa took up another ready bow.

sa: तमुवाच ततः प्रीतः स मुनिर्मुद्गलं ततः। त्वत्समो नास्ति लोकेऽस्मिन् दाता मात्सर्यवर्जितः॥२३।
en: Thereupon becoming very much pleased he thus spoke to the Rishi Mudgala, There is no other simpleand charitable being like you on earth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु कौन्तेयः सोऽवप्लुत्य रथोत्तमात्। तमन्वधावद् धावन्तं राजपुत्रं धनंजयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Saying this Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, coming down from the excellent car, pursued the prince who was thus running away.

sa: मदोऽष्टादशदोषः स्यात् त्यागो भवति षड् विधः। विपर्ययाः स्मृता एते मददोषा उदाहृताः॥
en: The eighteen vices constitute mada, renouncement is of six kinds, the Smritis call the reverse of these six sorts of renouncement as mada.

sa: ततो भल्लेन महता पृथुधारेण पाण्डवः। छत्रं चिच्छेद भीष्मस्य तूर्णं तदपतद् भुवि॥
en: Then with a huge and sharp dart, the son of Pandu quickly cut off Bhishma's umbrella and it fell down on the ground.

sa: नान्यस्मिन् पुरुषे सन्ति ये सत्यवति वै गुणाः। प्रदानमेव तस्मान्मे रोचते दुहितुस्तव॥
en: The qualities that are present in Satyavana are wanting in any other person. Therefore I command the bestowal of your daughter (on Satyavana).

sa: भीमेन च परामृष्टो दुर्बलो बलिना रणे। प्रास्पन्दत यथाप्राणं विचकर्ष च पाण्डवम्॥
en: Being thus assailed by the powerful Bhima in the encounter, he grew weak, trembled and tugged at the Pandava to his very best.

sa: न देवा दण्डमादाय रक्षन्ति पशुपालवत्। यं तु रक्षितुमिच्छन्ति बुद्ध्या संविभजन्ति तम्॥
en: The gods do not look after men with club in hands, like the herdsman. To those they want to protect, they give intelligence.

sa: शल्य उवाच ऋषयोऽथाब्रुवन् सर्वे देवाश्च त्रिदिवेश्वराः। अयं वै नहुष: श्रीमान् देवराज्येऽभिषिच्यताम्॥
en: Shalya said Then did all the gods and Yakshas with the Kinnaras say 'Anoint this handsome Nahusha in the kingship of the gods.'

sa: एष प्रह्लाद पुत्रस्ते मया दत्तो विरोचनः। पादप्रक्षालनं कुर्यात् कुमार्याः संनिधौ मम॥
en: This son of your, Virochana, who is given to you by me, O Prahrada, should wash my feet before the maiden. Since you

sa: बुद्ध्या भयं प्रणुदति तपसा विन्दते महत्। गुरुशुश्रूषया ज्ञानं शान्तिं योगेन विन्दति॥
en: Knowledge removes fear and greatness is attained by devotion; and by serving one's elders and by application both knowledge and happiness are secured.

sa: रुक्मपुङ्खाः सुतीक्ष्णाग्रा मुक्ता हस्तवता मया। छादयन्तु शराः पार्थं शलभा इव पादपम्॥
en: Discharged by my light hand these shafts, having highly sharpened points and feathered in gold, shall cover Partha like locusts covering a tree.

sa: आर्जवं प्रतिपद्यस्व पुत्रेषु सततं विभो। इह कीर्तिं परां प्राप्य प्रेत्य स्वर्गमवाप्स्यसि॥
en: O Lord, always show kindness to your sons; and thus you will attain to heaven after having gained great fame in this world.

sa: ततो मे त्रिगुणा यक्षा ये मद्वचनकारिणः। केचिदेव धनाध्यक्षं भ्रातरं मे समाश्रिताः॥
en: And thrice as many Yakshas carry out my orders. Some only are under the sway of my brother (Kubera) the lord of wealth.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ब्राह्मणं स्वयमाहूय याचमानमकिञ्चनम्। पश्चाननास्तीति यो ब्रूयात् सोऽक्षयं नरकं व्रजेत्।।१०४।
en: Yudhishthira replied He that himself having summoned a poor Brahmana asking (for alms), says that he has nothing, is doomed to eternal hell.

sa: उद्वेपते मे हृदयं ये मे दुर्योधनादयः। बाल्येऽपि तेन युध्यन्तो वारणेनेव मर्दिताः॥
en: My heart quakes that Duryodhana and other sons of mine even when fighting with him in their childhood were smashed as by elephants.

sa: सन्ति मे देवकन्याश्च गन्धर्वाणां च योषितः। सन्ति दानवकन्याश्च दैत्यानां चापि योषितः॥
en: Many daughters of the celestials and the Gandharvas are in my household and I possess several daughters of the Danavas and the Daityas.

sa: यो नैव रोषान्न भयान्न लोभान्नार्थकारणात्। न हेतुवादाद् धर्मात्मा सत्यं जह्यात् कदाचन॥
en: That man of virtuous soul who, through wealth and fear, avarice or wealth or for the sake of argument never falls from truth.

sa: मयस्य किल दैत्यस्य तदासीद् वेश्म राघव। तत्र प्रभावती नाम तपोऽतप्यत तापसी॥
en: O scion of Raghu's race, that palace belonged to the Daitya Maya. There a female ascetic Prabhavati by name, was engaged in austerities.

sa: रोहते सायकैर्विद्धं वनं परशुना हतम्। वाचा दुरुक्तं बीभत्सं न संरोहति वाक्क्षतम्॥
en: A forest, pierced by arrows or cut down by scythes, grows again; but the heart pierced with words, harsh and rude, never recovers.

sa: गोभिः पशुभिरश्चैश्च कृष्या च सुसमृद्धया। कुलानि न प्ररोहन्ति यानि हीनानि वृत्ततः॥
en: Families well possessed of knowledge, horses and other animals and agricultural produce are not worth regarding, if they are wanting in good manners.

sa: पूजयांचक्रिरे ते वै समायान्तं हलायुधम्। ततस्तं पाण्डवो राजा करे पस्पर्श पाणिना॥
en: And they assembled together did worship the approaching Halayudha. Then did the Pandava king touch him in the hand by his own hands.

sa: तत: प्राप्तं त्वया वीर ग्रहणं शत्रुभिर्बलात्॥ मोक्षितश्चासि धर्मज्ञैः पाण्डवैर्न च लज्जसे।
en: O hero, you were forcibly taken captive by the enemy; you were rescued by the virtuous Pandavas, but still you were not ashamed.

sa: स प्रविश्य पुरं राज्ञो नृपवेश्माभ्ययात् ततः। अवतीर्य रथात् तूर्णमाख्यातुं प्रविवेश ह॥
en: Entering the city of the king, he went to the palace and getting down from the car proceeded to relate (what took place).

sa: आचख्युस्तत्र रामाय महीं सागरमेखलाम्। विचितां न तु वैदेह्या दर्शनं रावणस्य वा॥
en: And they told Rama “Although we have searched the (entire) sea-girt earth, we have not found either the princess of Videha or Ravana.

sa: निक्षिप्य राजपुत्री तु तन्द्रीं मानं तथैव च। आतस्थे परमं यत्नं ब्राह्मणस्याभिराधने॥
en: And driving away her idleness and pride, the princess began to exert herself with the utmost care for the service of the Brahmana.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स पुत्रस्य वचः श्रुत्वा विराटो राष्ट्रवर्धनः। क्षमयामास कौन्तेयं भस्मच्छन्नमिवानलम्॥
en: Hearing the words of his son Virata, enhancer of the state begged pardon with the son of Kunti, radiant like fire within ashes,

sa: अत्र पूर्वं प्रसूता वै दाक्षायण्यः प्रजाः स्त्रियः। यस्यां दिशि प्रवृद्धाश्च कश्यपस्यात्मसम्भवाः॥
en: Here in days of old the female children of Daksha brought forth their children-the direction in which those born of Kashyapa grew up.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच यद्येतदमृतादस्ति कुण्डले वर्म चोत्तमम्। मम पुत्रस्य यं वै त्वं मत्त उत्पादयिष्यसि॥ अस्तु मे सङ्गमो देव यथोक्तं भगवंस्त्वया। त्वद्वीर्यरूपसत्त्वौजा धर्मयुक्तो भवेत् स च॥
en: Kunti said: If both the ear-rings and the armour of the son you will beget on me, be made of Amrita, then, O god, you may enjoy me, as your worshipful self has said. And may he (the son) be powerful, beautiful, strong energetic and virtuous like you.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच अपश्यत् संजयो नूनं कुन्तीपुत्रान् महारथान्। तैरस्य पुरुषव्याघे शमुद्वेजितं मनः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said Sanjaya, seeing these mighty car-warriors, the sons of Kunti, has certainly got his mind excited owing to those tigers among men.

sa: अत्र ध्वजवती नाम कुमारी हरिमेधसः। आकाशे तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति तस्थौ सूर्यस्य शासनात्॥
en: Here the daughter of Harimedhas named Dhvajavati remained fixed to the sky by the command of the sun who said-Remain here, remain here.

sa: शमं वै याचमानस्त्वं नाधर्मं तत्र लप्स्यसे। कुरून् विगर्हयिष्यन्ति धृतराष्ट्रं च पार्थिवाः॥
en: You will not be called sinful there; for you ask peace and the rulers of the earth will blame the Kurus and Dhritarashtra.

sa: किं तु संभन्धकं तुल्यमस्माकं कुरुपाण्डुषु। यथेष्टं वर्तमानेषु पाण्डवेषु च तेषु च॥
en: But our relations, are the same with the sons of Kuru and Pandu, whatever at this present moment might be those amongst themselves.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः शक्तिं प्रज्वलितां प्रतिगृह्य विशाम्पते। शस्त्रं गृहीत्वा निशितं सर्वगात्राण्यकृन्तत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then, O lord of the earth, accepting that blazing dart, Karna began to cut off his body with sharp weapons.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा तदर्जुनो वाक्यं राज्ञः पुत्रस्य भाषतः। अतीतसमये काले प्रियां भार्यामनिन्दिताम्॥ दुपदस्य सुतां तन्वीं पाञ्चालीं पावकात्मजाम्। सत्यार्जवगुणोपेतां भर्तुः प्रियहिते रताम्॥ उवाच रहसि प्रीतः कृष्णां सर्वार्थकोविदः। उत्तरं ब्रूहि कल्याणि क्षिप्रं मद्वचनादिदम्॥ अयं वै पाण्डवस्यासीत् सारथिः सम्मतो दृढः। महायुद्धेषु संसिद्धः स ते यन्ता भविष्यति॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing the words of the Prince, Arjuna, informed of all, after some time delightedly spoke in private to his beloved and faultless wife Krishna the princess of Panchala, the slender-made daughter of Drupada, born of sacrifice, gifted with the virtues of truthfulness and honesty and ever devoted to the well-being of her husband. "O auspicious lady, speak quickly to Uttara, at my request, that this (Brihannala) was formerly the firm and approved charioteer of Pandu's son (Arjuna); experienced in very many great battles he shall be your charioteer.”

sa: न वै मम हितं पूर्वं मातृवच्चेष्टितं त्वया। सा मां सम्बोधयस्यद्य केवलात्महितैषिणी॥
en: My good was never sought for by you as a mother and you now come to address me desiring the good of yourself,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा भीष्मः कुरुपितामहः। वैचित्रवीर्यं राजानमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Bhishma, the grandfather of the Kurus, having heard these words of his said these words to the royal son of Vichitravirya.

sa: तस्मिन् तौ शकुनौ बद्धौ युगपत् सहचारिणौ। तावुपादाय तं पाशं जग्मतुः खचरावुभौ॥
en: There were two birds, companions to each other, captured in that net and they both went up into the air with that net.

sa: विन्ध्ये चैव नगरश्रेष्ठे तव स्थानं हि शाश्वतम्। कालि कालि महाकालि खड्गखट्वाङ्गधारिणि॥
en: O Kali, Kali, O Mahakali, fond of wine, meat and animal-sacrifice your eternal abode is on the Vindhya, the chief of the mountains

sa: तं च वैद्या अकृपणा ब्राह्मणाः सर्वतोऽभयाः। प्रत्यषेधन्त राजानं श्लाघमानं पुनः पुनः॥
en: Several Brahrnanas, of really noble souls, acquainted with the Vedas and having nothing lo fear, forbade the king who was boasting too often.

sa: न हि संतप्यते तेन तथारूपेण कर्मणा। तथापि बुद्धि पापिष्ठा वर्धयन्त्यस्य मन्त्रिणः॥
en: And he dose not regret for doing that sort of acts; and his inclinations which are so vicious are supported by his advisers.

sa: तस्य भित्त्वा तनुत्राणं कायमभ्यगमच्छरः। ततः स तमसाऽऽविष्टो न स्म किंचित् प्रजज्ञिवान्॥
en: Boring through his coat of mail, that arrow penetrated into his body and he was deprived of the power of perception and consciousness.

sa: एष तिष्ठन् रथश्रेष्ठे रथे च रथिनां वरः। उत्कर्षति धनुः श्रेष्ठं गाण्डीवमशनिस्वनम्॥
en: The monkey strikes great terror into the hearts of all the soldiers. And sitting on that best of cars, the foremost of car-warriors.

sa: भीमसेनं च कौन्तेयं यस्य नास्ति समो बले। रणान्तकं तर्जयसे महावातमिव दुमः॥
en: Bhimasena too whose equal there it none in strength, you are roaring at this one who is equal to Yama himself in battle.

sa: शिखण्डिनं च पाञ्चाल्यं सहदेवं च मागधम्। एतान् सप्त महाभागान् वीरान् युद्धाभिकांक्षिणः॥
en: Shikhandin, the prince of Panchala Sahadeva and the king of Magadha summoning these seven heroes of great attributes who were anxious for war,

sa: विराट उवाच अहं खल्वपि संग्रामे शत्रूणां वशमागतः। मोक्षितो भीमसेनेन गावश्चापि जितास्तथा॥
en: Virata said When I passed into the hands of the enemies in battle, it was Bhimasena who saved me and rescued the kine.

sa: प्रीतोऽस्मि दर्शने विप्र ब्रूहि त्वं किं ददानि ते। एवमुक्तस्तु बलिना वामनः प्रत्युवाच ह॥ स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा बलिं देवः स्मयमानोऽभ्यभाषत। मेदिनी दानवपते देहि मे विक्रमत्रयम्॥
en: “I am pleased on seeing you, O Vipra, tell me what can I give you." Being thus accosted by Bali the dwarf replied. Saying "may good betide you" the Deity smilingly said to Bali, “O king of Danavas, give me land to cover my three footsteps."

sa: अवध्या ब्राह्मणा गावो ज्ञातयः शिशवः स्त्रियः। येषां चान्नानि भुञ्जीत ये च स्युः शरणागताः॥
en: The Brahmanas, cows, blood relations, infants and women must not be killed, as also those whose food we have eaten and who have come under our protection.

sa: सोऽयं मया च सहितो नारदेन च पन्नगः। त्रिलोकेशं सुरपतिं गत्वा पश्यतु वासवम्॥
en: Let this Naga therefore, accompanied by myself and Narada and going to the lord of the gods, the protector of the three worlds, see Vasava.

sa: न हि मे मोक्ष्यते जीवन मूढः सैन्धवको नृपः। पातालतलसंस्थोऽपि यदि शक्रोऽस्य सारथिः॥
en: I shall not let along the stupid king of Sindhu even if he finds shelter in the nether world or is supported by Indra himself.

sa: क्रियमाणे तथा पौत्रे पुत्रे च निधनं गते। कथमिच्छामि देवर्षे गुणकेशी स्नुषां प्रति॥
en: At his grandson being elected (for marriage) and at the death of his son. Aryaka said-"How can I desire, O Rishi, Gunakeshi for my daughter-in-law.

sa: स निवृत्तो नरव्याघ्रो मुञ्चन् वज्रनिभाञ्छरान्। सचिवैः संवृतो राजा रथे नाग इव श्वसन्॥
en: Thus addressed, the king Duryodhana, the foremost of men, sighing on his car like a snake, turned, surrounded by his ministers, and discharging thunder-like arrows.

sa: अष्टाविमानि हर्षस्य नवनीतानि भारत। वर्तमानानि दृश्यन्ते तान्येव स्वसुखान्यपि॥ समागमश्च सखिभिर्महांश्चैव धनागमः। पुत्रेण च परिष्वङ्गः संनिपातश्च मैथुने॥ समये च प्रियालाप: स्वयूथ्येषु समुन्नतिः। अभिप्रेतस्य लाभश्च पूजा च जनसंसदि॥
en: These eight are the creams of rejoicing, O son of Bharata and are obtained this world viz., union with friends, acquirement of immense wealth, embracing a son, intercourse in union, agreeable conversations at proper times, the advancement of the members of one's party, the attainment of desired results and honour and respect among men,

sa: वासुदेव उवाच संजयेदं वचो ब्रूया धृतराष्ट्र मनीषिणम्। कुरुमुख्यस्य भीष्मस्य द्रोणस्यापि च शृण्वतः॥
en: The son of Vasudeva said O Sanjaya, speak these words to the intelligent Dhritarashtra in the hearing of the foremost of Kurus, Bhishma and Drona.

sa: इत्युक्त्वान्तहिते तस्मिन् रामो नलमुवाच ह। कुरु सेतुं समुद्रे त्वं शक्तो ह्यसि मतो मम॥
en: Saying this the Ocean vanished. And then Rama said to Nala "build a bridge across the sea. For, in my opinion, you are able to do it."

sa: सावित्र्युवाच सुचिरं त्वं प्रसुप्तोऽसि ममाङ्के पुरुषर्षभ। गतः स भगवान् देवः प्रजायसंयमनो यमः॥
en: Savitri said: O best of men, you have (indeed) slept long on my lap. That god, the divine Yama, who governs all creatures, has departed.

sa: उशीनरं प्रतिग्राह्य गालवः प्रययौ वनम्। रेमे स तां समासाद्य कृतपुण्य इव श्रियम्॥
en: And having given her to Ushinara, Galava went to the forest and he (Ushinara) spotted in her company like a virtuous man enjoying his prosperity,

sa: तं त्वहं नावगच्छामि यो मे यन्ता भवेन्नरः। पश्यध्वं सारथिं क्षिप्रं मम युक्तं प्रयास्यतः॥
en: I do not know of a man who may be iny charioteer; find out out therefore quickly a charioteer who may suit me who am going out.

sa: मां सुखं प्रतिपद्यस्व दासो भीरु भवामि ते। अह्नाय तव सुश्रोणि शतं निष्कान् ददाम्यहम्॥ दासीशतं च ते दद्यां दासानामपि चापरम्। रथं चाश्वतरीयुक्तमस्तु नौ भीरु संगमः॥
en: O timid one, accept me happily; I shall become your slave. O you of beautiful hips, I shall give you anon a hundred Nishkas and a hundred male and a hundred female servants. I shall also bestow on you cars yoked with mules; ( beautiful one, let us be united.

sa: कण्व उवाच मातलिं प्रीतमनसं दृष्ट्वा सुमुखदर्शनात्। निवेदयामास तदा माहात्म्यं जन्म कर्म च॥
en: Kanya said Seeing Matali, of cheerful mind owing to his seeing Sumukha, Narada informed him the greatness, the birth and the works of that youth.

sa: न ते प्रकृतिमान् वर्णः कृशा पाण्डुश्च लक्ष्यसे। आचक्ष्व परिशेषेण सर्वं विद्यामहं यथा॥
en: Your complexion seems to have lost its natural hue; you appear lean and pale, tell me all in detail that I may know every thing.

sa: यक्ष उवाच यक्षोऽहमस्मि भद्रं ते नास्मि पक्षी जलेचरः॥ मयैते निहताः सर्वे भ्रातरस्ते महौजसः।
en: The Yaksha said : I am a Yaksha and not an aquatic bird. All hail to you. It is I who have slain your greatly energetic brothers.

sa: एतद् द्वारं त्रिलोकस्य स्वर्गस्य च सुखस्य च। एष पूर्वो दिशां भागो विशावोऽत्र यदीच्छसि॥
en: This is the gate of the three worlds and of heaven and happiness; this direction is the eastern quarter and we shall enter it if you like.

sa: शल्य उवाच एवमुक्ते तु देवेन ऋषयस्त्रिदशास्तथा। ययुः समेत्य सहिताः शक्रं कृत्वा पुरःसरम्॥
en: Shalya said The Rishis and the dwellers, of the third heaven being thus spoken to by that god, went together, with Shakra at their head.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं तेऽन्योन्यमामन्त्र्य कर्माण्युक्त्वा पृथक् पृथक् धौम्यमामन्त्रयामासुः स च तान् मन्त्रमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus having consulted one another and mentioned their own respective duties they asked the advice of Dhaumya and he also gave his advice.

sa: मा तात साहसं कार्षीर्मम पूर्वपरिग्रहः। प्रश्नानुक्त्वा तु कौन्तेय ततः पिब हरस्व च॥
en: O child, do not attempt this. It has been possessed by me before. First! answer my questions and then drink water kind take it away.

sa: यो हि तेजो यथाशक्ति न दर्शयति विक्रमात्। क्षत्रियो जीविताकाङ्क्षी स्तेन इत्येव तं विदुः॥
en: That Kshatriya, who being desirous of life, does not exercise his energy and power to the best of his ability, is said to be like a thief.

sa: महाबलं घोरतरं प्रवृद्धं जातं हरिं पर्वतकन्दरेषु। प्रसुप्तमुचं प्रपदेन हंसि यः क्रुद्धमायोत्स्यसि जिष्णुमुचम्॥
en: Your attempt at an encounter with the dreadful Jishnu is like arousing a powerful, dreadful, full grown and furious lion asleep in a mountain cave.

sa: परिष्वजत पाञ्चाली मध्यमं पाण्डुनन्दनम्॥ बाहुभ्यां परिरभ्यैनं प्राबोधयदनिन्दिता। सिंहं सुप्तं वने दुर्गे मृगराजवधूरिव।॥
en: Having clasped him with her arms that faultless one roused him from his bed just as lioness awakes a sleeping lion in a solitary forest.

sa: ऋषीणां च नदीनां च कुलानां च महात्मनाम्। प्रभवो नाधिगन्तव्यः स्त्रीणां दुश्चरितस्य च।॥
en: The greatness of Rishis, of rivers, of the banks of rivers and of the noble-minded cannot be conceived, as also the wickedness of a woman.

sa: तत् करिष्यन्ति कौन्तेया वासुदेवस्य सम्मतम्। न हि ते जातु शाम्येरवृते राज्येन कौरव॥
en: The sons of Kunti will do that with the approval of Vasudeva and they will not be pacified without the kingdom, O son of Kuru.

sa: पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च भवान् नः प्रथमः सुहृत्। सुराणामसुराणां च यथा वीर प्रजापतिः॥
en: You are the best well-wisher of ourselves, of both the Kurus and the Pandavas; as the hero Prajapati was of the Suras and the Asuras.

sa: अर्जुनस्तत् तथाकार्षीत् किं पुनः सर्व एव ते। स भ्रातृनभिजानीहि वृत्त्या तं प्रतिपादय॥
en: Such was the feat of Arjuna single; what will they all united not do? Treat them as your own brothers and give them their rights.

sa: ये वै भेदनशीलास्तु सकामा निस्त्रपाः शठाः। ये पापा इति विख्याताः संवासे परिगर्हिताः॥
en: Those whose habit is to cause disagreements, those who covetous, shameless and vicious are well known as unrighteous. The association with them should be avoided.

sa: दानं होमं दैवतं मङ्गलानि प्रायश्चित्तान् विविधाँल्लोकवादान्। एतानि यः कुरुते नैत्यकानि तस्योत्थानं देवता राधयन्ति॥
en: Charity, worship of the gods, auspicious ceremonies and the several penances laid down by men-the gods exert themselves for the advancement of him who practices these daily.

sa: न हि ते वृजिनं किंचिद् वर्तते परमण्वपि। अस्मिन् मार्गे निषीदेयुः सेन्द्रा अपि सुरासुराः॥
en: (By following this path) you have not incurred even an atom of sin. The gods together with Indra and the Asuras have (sometimes) to adopt this path.

sa: शल्य उवाच गच्छ दुर्योधन पुरं स्वकमेव नरर्षभ। अहं गमिष्ये द्रष्टुं वै युधिष्ठिरमरिंदमम्॥
en: Shalya said O Duryodhana, O you best among men, go to your own capital, I shall go to see that subduer of his enemies, Yudhishthira.

sa: ध्वजे हि तस्मिन् रूपाणि चक्रुस्ते देवमायया। महाधनानि दिव्यानि महान्ति च लघूनि च॥
en: And those forms they included in the banner by the help of divine illusion-these forms, large and small, of heavenly origin and of great value.

sa: यत्र गत्वा न शोचन्ति न व्यथन्ति चलन्ति वा। तदहं स्थानमत्यन्तं मार्गयिष्यामि केवलम्॥
en: Those men who are free from conflicting emotions and those that have restrained their and those that given to contemplation and Yoga can go there.

sa: सर्वं तदपि जानामि करिष्यति च पाण्डवः। न ह्यस्य त्रिषु लोकेषु सदृशोऽन्ति धनुर्धरः॥
en: Will all be done by the son of Pandu, I know. In the three worlds there is no wilder of the bow equal to him.

sa: ते विवाहार्थमानीता वयं सर्वे तथा भवान्। कृते विवाहे मुदिता गमिष्यामो गृहान् प्रति॥
en: We all have been invited here and you as well for the wedding and the ceremony being over we shall go well pleased homeward bound.

sa: बलदेव उवाच विदितं ते नरव्याघ्र सर्वं भवितुमर्हति। यन्मयोक्तं विराटस्य पुरा वैवाहिके तदा॥
en: O you best among men, it is fitting that what was said by me at the time of the marriage, should be known to you.

sa: वयं पुनः सप्तदशेषु कृष्णे कुलेषु सर्वेऽनवमेषु जाताः। घड्भ्योगुणेभ्योऽभ्यधिका विहीनान् मन्यामहे द्रौपदि पाण्डुपुत्रान्॥
en: We too, O Krishna, are born in the seventeen races and are endowed with six royal qualities. We consider, O Draupadi, Pandavas as inferior men.
